descriptionByLocale.it:
NVIDIA sta trasformando la grafica del computer, il gioco del PC e l'elaborazione accelerata da più di 25 anni. È un’eredità unica dell’innovazione alimentata da una grande tecnologia e da persone incredibili. Oggi, stiamo toccando il potenziale illimitato di AI per definire la prossima era di calcolo. Un'epoca in cui la nostra GPU agisce come il cervello di computer, robot e auto-driving automobili che possono comprendere il mondo. Fare ciò che non è mai stato fatto prima di prendere visione, innovazione e il miglior talento del mondo. Come NVIDIAN, sarete immersi in un ambiente diversificato e di supporto, dove tutti si ispirano a fare il loro lavoro migliore. Unisciti alla squadra e scopri come puoi avere un impatto duraturo sul mondo.

Stiamo cercando un Senior HPC e AI Network Software Architect per contribuire a costruire la prossima generazione di infrastrutture AI scalabili. Il ruolo sottolinea la formazione distribuita, l'inferenza in tempo reale e l'efficienza della comunicazione attraverso grandi sistemi. Sviluppi nuovi approcci software e hardware, modella l'evoluzione della piattaforma attraverso l'innovazione hands-on e contribuisce a progettare sistemi che alimentano i carichi di lavoro AI più veloci a livello globale. Collabora con il nostro team di ricercatori e ingegneri che costruiscono software e hardware per l'IA in una scala eccezionale.

Cosa farai:

• Costruire ed evolvere l'architettura di sistemi software scalabili per la formazione e l'inferenza di AI distribuiti, concentrandosi su throughput, latenza, resilienza e l'efficienza della memoria attraverso le implementazioni su scala di cluster.

• Sviluppare e valutare le capacità di comunicazione e runtime di nuova generazione in librerie come NCCL, UCX e UCC, adattate alle esigenze in evoluzione dei carichi di lavoro AI di frontiera.

• Partner con team di framework AI (ad esempio TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX) e team di piattaforme interne per costruire integrazioni, esplorare nuovi approcci e migliorare le prestazioni e l'affidabilità end-to-end.

• Collaborare su funzionalità hardware e di livello di sistema attraverso GPU, DPU e interconnessioni per velocizzare il movimento dei dati e abilitare nuove funzionalità per la formazione, l'inferenza e il modello che servono in scala.

• Guida l'innovazione attraverso sistemi runtime, librerie di comunicazione e strati di protocollo specifici per l'intelligenza artificiale, aiutando a trasformare nuove idee in funzionalità pratiche e implementazioni robuste.

Cosa dobbiamo vedere:

• Ph.D., o equivalente esperienza del settore, in informatica, ingegneria informatica, o un campo strettamente correlato.

• 5+ anni di esperienza nella programmazione di sistemi, calcolo parallelo o distribuito, networking ad alte prestazioni o movimento di dati su larga scala, tra cui la progettazione di esperienze e sistemi complessi di costruzione.

• Forte background di programmazione in C++, Python, e idealmente CUDA o altri modelli di programmazione GPU, con un track record di produzione-qualità di prestazioni-critical software.

• Ampia esperienza pratica con i framework AI (per esempio PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) e una solida comprensione di come le librerie di comunicazione e i sistemi runtime facilitino la formazione su larga scala e l'inferenza.

• Dimostrato successo nello sviluppo e nella raffinazione di sistemi ad alto rendimento, bassa latenza, tra cui la capacità di ragionare tra stack software, funzionalità hardware e strozzature di sistema.

• Forte capacità di collaborazione in un ambiente multi-nazionale, interdisciplinare, con la capacità di contribuire idee, costruire slancio e lavorare efficacemente con ingegneri senior, ricercatori e team partner.

Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:

• Profonda competenza con le librerie di comunicazione NCCL, UCX, UCC o simili utilizzate nei carichi di lavoro AI e HPC su larga scala.

• Forte sfondo nei protocolli di rete e comunicazione, RDMA, comunicazioni collettive, trasporto congestion-aware, o networking acceleratore-consapevole.

• Conoscenza completa della formazione e dell'inferenza di modelli di grandi dimensioni che servono a scala, compresi i colli di bottiglia di comunicazione, le sfide di programmazione e i tradeoff di livello di sistema in elaborazione, memoria e tessuto.

• Esperienza artigianato hardware-software co-design per i sistemi AI distribuiti, compreso il contributo
descriptionByLocale.en:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are looking for a Senior HPC and AI Network Software Architect to help build the next generation of scalable AI infrastructure. The role emphasizes distributed training, real-time inference, and communication efficiency across large systems. You will develop new software and hardware approaches, shape platform evolution through hands-on innovation, and contribute to designing systems powering the fastest AI workloads globally. Collaborate with our distinguished team of researchers and engineers building software and hardware for AI at an outstanding scale.

What you will be doing:

• Build and evolve the architecture of scalable software systems for distributed AI training and inference, focusing on throughput, latency, resiliency, and memory efficiency across cluster-scale deployments.

• Develop and evaluate next-generation communication and runtime capabilities in libraries such as NCCL, UCX, and UCC, tailored to the evolving demands of frontier AI workloads.

• Partner with AI framework teams (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX) and internal platform teams to build integrations, explore new approaches, and improve end-to-end performance and reliability.

• Collaborate on hardware and system-level features across GPUs, DPUs, and interconnects to speed up data movement and enable new capabilities for training, inference, and model serving at scale.

• Drive innovation across runtime systems, communication libraries, and AI-specific protocol layers, helping turn new ideas into practical capabilities and robust implementations.

What we need to see:

• Ph.D., or equivalent industry experience, in computer science, computer engineering, or a closely related field.

• 5+ years of experience in systems programming, parallel or distributed computing, high-performance networking, or large-scale data movement, including experience designing and building complex systems.

• Strong programming background in C++, Python, and ideally CUDA or other GPU programming models, with a track record of building production-quality performance-critical software.

• Extensive hands-on experience with AI frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) and a solid grasp of how communication libraries and runtime systems facilitate large-scale training and inference.

• Demonstrated success in developing and refining high-throughput, low-latency systems, including the ability to reason across software stacks, hardware capabilities, and system bottlenecks.

• Strong collaboration skills in a multi-national, interdisciplinary setting, with the ability to contribute ideas, build momentum, and work effectively with senior engineers, researchers, and partner teams.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Deep expertise with NCCL, UCX, UCC, or similar communication libraries used in large-scale AI and HPC workloads.

• Strong background in networking and communication protocols, RDMA, collective communications, congestion-aware transport, or accelerator-aware networking.

• Comprehensive knowledge of large model training and inference serving at scale, including communication bottlenecks, scheduling challenges, and system-level tradeoffs across compute, memory, and fabric.

Heute nutzen wir das unbegrenzte Potenzial der KI, um die nächste Ära des Computing zu definieren. Eine Ära, in der unsere GPU als Gehirn von Computern, Robotern und selbstfahrenden Autos fungiert, die die Welt verstehen können. Zu tun, was noch nie zuvor getan wurde, erfordert Vision, Innovation und die besten Talente der Welt. Als NVIDIAN werden Sie in eine vielfältige, unterstützende Umgebung eintauchen, in der jeder dazu inspiriert ist, seine beste Arbeit zu leisten. Treten Sie dem Team bei und sehen Sie, wie Sie die Welt nachhaltig beeinflussen können.

• Fördern Sie Innovationen über Laufzeitsysteme, Kommunikationsbibliotheken und KI-spezifische Protokollschichten hinweg und helfen Sie dabei, neue Ideen in praktische Fähigkeiten und robuste Implementierungen umzuwandeln.

• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Systemprogrammierung, Parallel- oder Distributed-Computing, Hochleistungsnetzwerken oder groß angelegten Datenbewegungen, einschließlich Erfahrung beim Entwerfen und Erstellen komplexer Systeme.

• Starker Programmierhintergrund in C++, Python und idealerweise CUDA oder anderen GPU-Programmierungsmodellen mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Erstellung leistungskritischer Software in Produktionsqualität.

Möglichkeiten, sich von der Masse abzuheben:

descriptionByLocale.fr:
NVIDIA transforme le graphisme informatique, le jeu PC et l'informatique accélérée depuis plus de 25 ans. C'est un héritage unique d'innovation qui est alimenté par de grandes technologies – et des gens incroyables. Aujourd'hui, nous utilisons le potentiel illimité de l'IA pour définir la prochaine ère de l'informatique. Une époque où notre GPU agit comme le cerveau d'ordinateurs, de robots et de voitures autonomes qui peuvent comprendre le monde. Faire ce qui n'a jamais été fait avant prend la vision, l'innovation, et le monde des meilleurs talents. En tant que NVIDIAN, vous serez immergé dans un environnement diversifié et solidaire où tout le monde est inspiré à faire son meilleur travail. Venez rejoindre l'équipe et voir comment vous pouvez avoir un impact durable sur le monde.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un architecte principal de logiciels HPC et AI Network pour aider à construire la prochaine génération d'infrastructure d'IA évolutive. Ce rôle met l'accent sur la formation distribuée, l'inférence en temps réel et l'efficacité de la communication dans les grands systèmes. Vous développerez de nouvelles approches logicielles et matérielles, façonnerez l'évolution de la plateforme grâce à l'innovation pratique et contribuerez à la conception de systèmes qui alimentent les charges de travail les plus rapides en matière d'IA à l'échelle mondiale. Collaborez avec notre équipe distinguée de chercheurs et d'ingénieurs qui construisent des logiciels et du matériel pour l'IA à une échelle exceptionnelle.

Ce que vous ferez :

• Bâtir et développer l'architecture de systèmes logiciels évolutifs pour la formation et l'inférence distribuées en matière d'IA, en mettant l'accent sur le débit, la latence, la résilience et l'efficacité de la mémoire dans les déploiements à l'échelle des grappes.

• Élaborer et évaluer des capacités de communication et d'exécution de la prochaine génération dans des bibliothèques comme le CCNL, l'UCX et l'UCC, adaptées à l'évolution de la charge de travail liée à l'IA.

• Partenaire avec des équipes-cadres d'IA (p. ex. TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX) et des équipes de plateformes internes pour construire des intégrations, explorer de nouvelles approches et améliorer les performances et la fiabilité de bout en bout.

• Collaborer sur le matériel et les fonctionnalités au niveau du système à travers les GPU, les DPU et les interconnexions pour accélérer le mouvement des données et permettre de nouvelles capacités pour la formation, l'inférence et le modèle servant à l'échelle.

• Conduire l'innovation à travers les systèmes d'exécution, les bibliothèques de communication et les couches de protocole spécifiques à l'IA, en aidant à transformer de nouvelles idées en capacités pratiques et en implémentations robustes.

Ce que nous devons voir :

• Ph.D., ou expérience équivalente de l'industrie, en informatique, en génie informatique ou dans un domaine étroitement lié.

• 5+ ans d'expérience dans la programmation de systèmes, le calcul parallèle ou distribué, le réseautage à haute performance ou le mouvement de données à grande échelle, y compris l'expérience dans la conception et la construction de systèmes complexes.

• Forte expérience de programmation en C++, Python, et idéalement CUDA ou d'autres modèles de programmation GPU, avec une expérience de construction de logiciels de qualité de production et de performance critiques.

• Une vaste expérience pratique des cadres d'intelligence artificielle (p. ex. PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) et une bonne compréhension de la façon dont les bibliothèques de communication et les systèmes d'exécution facilitent la formation et l'inférence à grande échelle.

• Le succès démontré dans le développement et le raffinage de systèmes à haut débit et à faible latence, y compris la capacité de raisonner entre les piles de logiciels, les capacités matérielles et les goulets d'étranglement du système.

• Fortes compétences en collaboration dans un cadre multinational et interdisciplinaire, avec la capacité de contribuer aux idées, de créer de l'élan et de travailler efficacement avec des ingénieurs chevronnés, des chercheurs et des équipes partenaires.

Des façons de se démarquer de la foule :

• Expertise approfondie des bibliothèques de communications CCNL, UCX, UCC ou similaires utilisées dans les charges de travail à grande échelle liées à l'IA et au HPC.

• Forte expérience dans les protocoles de réseautage et de communication, RDMA, les communications collectives, le transport de congestion-consommateur, ou le réseau d'accélérateur-consommateur.

• Connaissance approfondie de la formation et de l'inférence des grands modèles à l'échelle, y compris les goulots d'étranglement dans les communications, les défis liés à l'établissement des calendriers et les compromis au niveau des systèmes entre les systèmes de calcul, de mémoire et de tissu.

• Expérience de conception co-conception matériel-logiciel pour les systèmes d'IA distribués, y compris contribution

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per due decenni, NVIDIA è pioniera del visual computing, dell'arte e della scienza della grafica informatica. Con la nostra invenzione della GPU - il motore del moderno calcolo visivo - il campo si è ampliato per comprendere i giochi per PC, la produzione di film, il design del prodotto, la diagnosi medica, la ricerca scientifica e tutte le cose AI. Oggi, l'intelligenza artificiale e il calcolo visivo stanno diventando sempre più centrali per come le persone interagiscono con la tecnologia, e non c'è mai stato un momento più emozionante per unirsi al nostro team. Stiamo ora cercando un Principal Developer Technology Engineer di concentrarsi sul rendering avanzato, tra cui il tracciamento del percorso e la grafica neurale, e l'adozione più ampia della tecnologia AI nei giochi. Cosa farai:
• Collabora con alcuni dei più innovativi sviluppatori AAA di tutto il mondo per ottimizzare le prestazioni di GPU e di sistema, per garantire il gameplay più veloce e fluido con un bellissimo percorso tracciato rendering neurale e complessi comportamenti AI.
• Sviluppare, profilare, ottimizzare e sintonizzare algoritmi di rendering neurali e modelli AI per sfruttare al meglio le risorse di calcolo disponibili.
• Collabora con i team di architettura e driver di NVIDIA per garantire la migliore esperienza possibile sull'hardware di generazione attuale, e per determinare tendenze e caratteristiche per le architetture di nuova generazione.
• Gioca con l'ultima tecnologia GPU per sviluppare nuove tecniche utilizzando GPU, costruire demo tecnici, scrivere whitepaper e presentare il vostro lavoro a conferenze. Cosa dobbiamo vedere:
• Laurea magistrale in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, o relativo grado di scienza focalizzato computazionalmente (o esperienza equivalente).
• Hai 15 anni di esperienza lavorativa o di ricerca rilevanti.
• Proficienza in C++ con forte sviluppo software, ottimizzazione, abilità di debug e un forte background di ingegneria del software.
• Competenze matematiche molto forti, tra cui algebra lineare e calcolo per la risoluzione dei problemi e la modellazione delle prestazioni.
• Ottima conoscenza della grafica in tempo reale e delle tecnologie GPU (algoritmi di rendering in tempo reale, tra cui tracciamento ray/path, shader, linguaggi di ombreggiatura e API come DirectX o Vulkan).
• Esperienza pratica con ottimizzazione delle prestazioni a basso livello.
• Competenze approfondite con i fondamentali dell'architettura CPU e GPU.
• Una solida comprensione dei fondamenti AI con la capacità di utilizzare non solo gli strumenti AI per la produttività di programmazione, ma anche per progettare nuove soluzioni.
• Buone capacità di comunicazione, organizzazione e priorità.
• Aperto a viaggiare per visite in loco con sviluppatori e per conferenze. Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:
• Esperienza professionale in algoritmi di machine learning e applicazioni.
• Esperienza ottimizzando i carichi di lavoro di inferenza e formazione.
• Solida comprensione delle tecniche di grafica neurale.
• Esperienza con lo sviluppo del driver Windows o Linux. #LI-Hybrid # Il tuo stipendio base sarà determinato in base alla tua posizione, esperienza e la paga dei dipendenti in posizioni simili. Per la Polonia: la gamma di stipendio base è 483,750 PLN - 838.500 PLN.
descriptionByLocale.en:
For two decades, NVIDIA has pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics. With our invention of the GPU - the engine of modern visual computing - the field has expanded to encompass PC games, movie production, product design, medical diagnosis, scientific research and all things AI. Today, AI and visual computing are becoming increasingly central to how people interact with technology, and there has never been a more exciting time to join our team.

We are now looking for a Principal Developer Technology Engineer to focus on advanced rendering, including path tracing and neural graphics, and the broader adoption of AI technology in games.

What you’ll be doing:

• Collaborate with some of the most innovative, leading AAA developers throughout the world to optimize GPU and system performance, to ensure the fastest and most fluid gameplay with beautiful path traced neural rendering and complex AI behaviors.

• Develop, profile, optimize, and tune neural rendering algorithms and AI models to make the most of available computing resources.

• Collaborate with the architecture and driver teams at NVIDIA in ensuring the best possible experience on current generation hardware, and on determining trends and features for next generation architectures.

• Play with the latest GPU technology to develop new techniques using GPUs, build technical demos, write whitepapers and present your work at conferences.

What we need to see:

• Masters degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related computationally focused science degree (or equivalent experience).

• You have 15+ years of relevant work experience or research.

• Proficiency in C++ with strong software development, optimization, debugging skills, and a strong software engineering background.

• Very strong math skills, including linear algebra and calculus for problem-solving and performance modeling.

• Excellent knowledge of real-time graphics and GPU technologies (real-time rendering algorithms including ray/path tracing, shaders, shading languages, and APIs such as DirectX or Vulkan).

• Hands-on experience with low-level performance optimizations.

• In-depth expertise with CPU and GPU architecture fundamentals.

• A solid understanding of AI fundamentals with the ability to not only use AI tools for programming productivity but also to design new solutions.

• Good communication, organization and prioritization skills.

• Open to travel for on-site visits with developers and for conferences.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Professional experience in machine learning algorithms and applications.

• Experience optimizing inference and training workloads.

• Solid understanding of Neural Graphics techniques.

• Experience with Windows or Linux driver development.

#LI-Hybrid

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. For Poland: The base salary range is 483,750 PLN - 838,500 PLN.

Depuis deux décennies, NVIDIA est le pionnier de l'informatique visuelle, de l'art et de la science de l'informatique graphique. Avec notre invention du GPU - le moteur de l'informatique visuelle moderne - le domaine s'est élargi pour englober les jeux PC, la production de films, la conception de produits, le diagnostic médical, la recherche scientifique et toutes choses AI. Aujourd'hui, l'IA et l'informatique visuelle sont de plus en plus au centre de la façon dont les gens interagissent avec la technologie, et il n'y a jamais eu de temps plus excitant pour rejoindre notre équipe. Nous sommes maintenant à la recherche d'un ingénieur principal en technologie de développement pour se concentrer sur le rendu avancé, y compris le tracé de chemin et les graphismes neuronaux, et l'adoption plus large de la technologie de l'IA dans les jeux. • Maîtrise en informatique, en génie informatique ou en sciences connexes axées sur le calcul (ou expérience équivalente).

• Compétence en C++ avec un solide développement logiciel, l'optimisation, les compétences de débogage et une solide formation en ingénierie logicielle.
• Très fortes compétences en mathématiques, y compris l'algèbre linéaire et le calcul pour la résolution de problèmes et la modélisation de performance.

descriptionByLocale.it:
NVIDIA sta trasformando la grafica del computer, il gioco del PC e l'elaborazione accelerata da più di 25 anni. È un’eredità unica dell’innovazione alimentata da una grande tecnologia e da persone incredibili.

Oggi, stiamo toccando il potenziale illimitato di AI per definire la prossima era di calcolo. Un'epoca in cui la nostra GPU agisce come il cervello di computer, robot e auto-driving automobili che possono comprendere il mondo. Fare ciò che non è mai stato fatto prima di prendere visione, innovazione e il miglior talento del mondo. Come NVIDIAN, sarete immersi in un ambiente diversificato e di supporto, dove tutti si ispirano a fare il loro lavoro migliore. Unisciti alla squadra e scopri come puoi avere un impatto duraturo sul mondo.

Stiamo cercando un HPC Performance Engineer nel nostro gruppo di compilatori e strumenti NVHPC. I nostri ingegneri di performance analizzano le applicazioni di High Performance Computing (HPC) con l'intento di migliorare le prestazioni guidando le ottimizzazioni dei compilatori e i miglioramenti delle librerie. Questo ruolo offre la possibilità di lavorare con una vasta gamma di applicazioni, da piccoli benchmark in esecuzione su core single-CPU a applicazioni full-scale in esecuzione su sistemi multi-nodi multi-GPU. Troverete opportunità di ottimizzazione e lavorare a stretto contatto con i nostri team di sviluppo del compilatore e di ingegneria delle applicazioni per fornire soluzioni efficaci.

Cosa farai:

• Analizzare l'effetto di diversi compilatori e ottimizzazioni dei compilatori sulle prestazioni delle applicazioni HPC.

• Valutare se e come il compilatore e il runtime possono migliorare le prestazioni delle applicazioni chiave HPC sulle piattaforme CPU e CPU/GPU.

• Comunicare i limiti delle capacità di compilatore con l'ingegneria delle applicazioni per guidare il percorso migliore verso il miglioramento delle prestazioni.

• Porta applicazioni HPC a diverse piattaforme e modelli di programmazione.

• Valutare l'impatto dei componenti del pacchetto NVHPC, del driver del dispositivo e della configurazione del sistema sulle prestazioni dell'applicazione.

Cosa dobbiamo vedere:

• BS/MS o esperienza equivalente in Informatica o in un campo di ingegneria correlato.

• 5+ anni di esperienza di programmazione.

• Solida comprensione di Fortran, C, C++ e tecniche di programmazione, soprattutto per architetture parallele, preferibilmente per i compilatori.

• Esperienza con OpenACC, OpenMP, MPI, CUDA e Parallelismo linguistico standard.

• Forti competenze nell'analisi delle prestazioni e nell'ottimizzazione, nonché una vasta comprensione degli strumenti di sviluppo delle applicazioni parallele e degli ambienti runtime.

• Forti fondamenti matematici, tra cui algebra lineare e metodi numerici.

• Comprendere considerazioni sulle prestazioni, tradeoff e impatto.

• Competenti competenze interpersonali, un approccio logico a problem-solving, buona gestione del tempo e competenze di priorità compito. Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale, insieme alla capacità di lavorare in un team di sviluppo dinamico.

Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:

• Avete una profonda comprensione delle architetture delle macchine e delle micro-architetture.

• L'esperienza con il debug e il porting e la programmazione del linguaggio di montaggio è un vantaggio significativo.

NVIDIA si impegna a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e orgoglioso di essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Poiché apprezziamo molto la diversità nei nostri dipendenti attuali e futuri, non discriminate (anche nelle nostre pratiche di assunzione e promozione) sulla base di razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, stato civile, stato veterano, stato di disabilità o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge.

Ampiamente considerato uno dei datori di lavoro più desiderabili del mondo tecnologico, NVIDIA offre stipendi altamente competitivi e un pacchetto completo di benefici. Mentre pianificate il vostro futuro, vedere cosa possiamo offrire a voi e alla vostra famiglia www.nvidiabenefits.com/
descriptionByLocale.en:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are looking for a HPC Performance Engineer in our NVHPC compilers & tools group. Our performance engineers analyze High Performance Computing (HPC) applications with the intent of improving performance by driving compiler optimizations and library enhancements. This role offers the chance to work with a wide range of applications, from small benchmarks running on single-CPU core to full-scale applications running on multi-node multi-GPU systems. You'll find optimization opportunities and work closely with our compiler development and application engineering teams to deliver effective solutions.

What you'll be doing:

• Analyze the effect of different compilers and compiler optimizations on HPC application performance.

• Evaluate whether and how the compiler and runtime can improve the performance of key HPC applications on CPU and CPU/GPU platforms.

• Communicate limits of compiler capabilities with application engineering to guide the best path forward towards improving performance.

• Port HPC applications to different platforms and programming models.

• Evaluate the impact of NVHPC package components, device driver, and system configuration on application performance.

What we need to see:

• BS/MS or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related engineering field.

• 5+ years of programming experience.

• Solid understanding of Fortran, C, C++, and programming techniques, especially for parallel architectures, preferably for compilers.

• Experience with OpenACC, OpenMP, MPI, CUDA and Standard Language Parallelism.

• Strong skills in performance analysis and tuning, as well as a broad understanding of parallel applications development tools and runtime environments.

• Strong mathematical fundamentals, including linear algebra and numerical methods.

• Understand performance considerations, tradeoffs, and impact.

• Expert interpersonal skills, a logical approach to problem-solving, good time management, and task prioritization skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, along with the ability to work in a dynamic development team.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• You have a deep understanding of machine architectures and micro-architectures.

• Experience with debugging and porting as well as assembly language programming is a significant advantage.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/
descriptionByLocale.de:

Was wir sehen müssen:

• Starke Fähigkeiten in der Leistungsanalyse und -abstimmung sowie ein breites Verständnis von parallelen Anwendungsentwicklungstools und Laufzeitumgebungen.

Möglichkeiten, sich von der Masse abzuheben:

• Sie haben ein tiefes Verständnis für Maschinenarchitekturen und Mikroarchitekturen.

• Erfahrung mit Debugging und Portierung sowie Assemblersprachenprogrammierung ist ein wesentlicher Vorteil.

NVIDIA engagiert sich für ein vielfältiges Arbeitsumfeld und ist stolz darauf, ein Arbeitgeber mit gleichen Chancen zu sein. descriptionByLocale.it:
NVIDIA sta cambiando il mondo di AI Networking con la tecnologia innovativa. Siamo entusiasti di aggiungere un AI Networking Software Developer al nostro team di sviluppo e codesign di AI Networking SW. Lavoriamo con le ultime tecnologie e hardware NVIDIA. Facciamo il benchmarking a stack completo per i sistemi di scala Data Center per la formazione/l'inferenza di AI e i benchmark di livello inferiore. Ci sforziamo di automazione e sviluppiamo molti strumenti in-house ancora adottare le pratiche e le strutture accettate dalla comunità. Inoltre ridiamo alla comunità sviluppando i nostri strumenti nei repository GitHub pubblici. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di garantire che i sistemi su larga scala offrono prestazioni attesi in pratica, non solo su carta, scoprendo strozzature e guidando miglioramenti continui.

Cosa farai?

• Sviluppare framework di comunicazione di rete AI e applicazioni in esecuzione in produzione sui più grandi supercomputer e data center del mondo.

• Sviluppare strumenti di produzione e benchmark utilizzati da più team all'interno e all'esterno di NVIDIA.

• Abilitare nuovi modelli AI all'interno della nostra infrastruttura di benchmarking e fornire informazioni attraverso l'analisi end-to-end di carichi di lavoro su larga scala attraverso stack hardware e software.

• Progettazione e realizzazione di sistemi di automazione, tra cui ricerca di parametri su larga scala per identificare configurazioni ottimali in sistemi complessi.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con team di networking e hardware per co-disegnare nuove funzionalità e interfacce software in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione.

Cosa dobbiamo vedere:

• Laurea, laurea in Informatica / ingegneria del software, e 5+ anni o esperienza equivalente.

• Esperienza di sviluppo professionale Python. Cerchiamo persone che costruiscono strumenti manutenbili e di lunga durata che non impongono un pesante carico al team in termini di manutenzione.

• Competenze e passione di Linux solide per lavorare in ambienti di linea di comando.

• Capacità di lavorare su uno stack ampio e in evoluzione, con un forte impulso da imparare, dall'hardware e dalla rete fino a sistemi AI su larga scala in esecuzione su interi cluster

Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:

• Conoscenza e/o esperienza con il moderno ecosistema AI: PyTorch, LLMs, inferenza e formazione.

• Familiarità con sistemi di orchestrazione a grappolo come Slurm o Kubernetes.

• Conoscenza in MPI e HPC, InfiniBand, Ethernet e Networking.

• Esperienza nelle ottimizzazioni delle prestazioni

Per due decenni, abbiamo pionieristico calcolo visivo, e l'arte e la scienza della grafica del computer. Con la nostra invenzione della GPU - il motore del moderno calcolo visivo - il campo si è ampliato per comprendere videogiochi, produzione di film, product design, diagnosi medica e ricerca scientifica. Oggi, siamo all'inizio della prossima era, l'era informatica AI, accesi da un nuovo modello di calcolo, GPU deep learning. Questo nuovo modello - dove le reti neurali profonde sono addestrate a riconoscere modelli da quantità massiccia di dati - ha dimostrato di essere profondamente efficace nella soluzione di alcuni dei problemi più complessi nella vita quotidiana. NVIDIA è ampiamente considerato una delle aziende più desiderabili del mondo tecnologico per cui lavorare. Sei creativo e guidato? Ti piace una sfida? Se è così, vogliamo sentire da voi.
descriptionByLocale.en:
NVIDIA is changing the world of AI Networking with groundbreaking technology. We are excited to be adding an AI Networking Software Developer to our AI Networking SW development and codesign team. We are working with the latest NVIDIA hardware and technologies. We do full stack benchmarking for Data Center scale systems for AI training/inference and lower level benchmarks. We strive for automation and develop many tools in-house yet adopt community accepted practices and frameworks. Moreover we give back to community developing our own tools in public GitHub repositories. Our goal is to ensure that large-scale systems deliver expected performance in practice, not just on paper, by uncovering bottlenecks and driving continuous improvements.

What you'll be doing :

• Developing AI networking communication frameworks and applications running in production on the world’s largest supercomputers and data centers.

• Develop production tools and benchmarks used by multiple teams inside and outside NVIDIA.

• Enable new AI models within our benchmarking infrastructure and deliver insights through end-to-end analysis of large-scale workloads across hardware and software stacks.

• Design and implement automation systems, including large-scale parameter search to identify optimal configurations across complex systems.

• Collaborate closely with networking and hardware teams to co-design new features and software interfaces in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

What we need to see:

• B.Sc., M.Sc degree in Computer Science / Software engineering, and 5+ years or equivalent experience.

• Professional Python development experience. We seek individuals who build maintainable, long-lived tools that do not impose a heavy burden on the team in terms of maintenance.

• Solid Linux expertise and passion for working extensively in command-line environments.

• Ability to work across a broad and evolving stack, with a strong drive to learn—from hardware and networking up to large-scale AI systems running across entire clusters

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Knowledge and/or experience with modern AI ecosystem: PyTorch, LLMs, inference and training.

• Familiarity with cluster orchestration systems such as Slurm or Kubernetes.

• Knowledge in MPI and HPC, InfiniBand, Ethernet and Networking.

• Experience in performance optimizations

For two decades, we have pioneered visual computing, and the art and science of computer graphics. With our invention of the GPU - the engine of modern visual computing - the field has expanded to encompass video games, movie production, product design, medical diagnosis and scientific research. Today, we stand at the beginning of the next era, the AI computing era, ignited by a new computing model, GPU deep learning. This new model - where deep neural networks are trained to recognize patterns from massive amounts of data - has shown to be deeply effective at solving some of the most complex problems in everyday life. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable companies to work for. Are you creative and driven? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you.
descriptionByLocale.de:
NVIDIA verändert die Welt des AI Networking mit bahnbrechender Technologie. Wir freuen uns, einen AI Networking Software Developer in unser AI Networking SW Entwicklungs- und Codesign-Team aufzunehmen. Wir arbeiten mit der neuesten NVIDIA Hardware und Technologien. Wir führen Full-Stack-Benchmarking für Data Center-Skala-Systeme für KI-Training / Inferenz und niedrigere Benchmarks durch. Wir streben nach Automatisierung und entwickeln viele Tools im eigenen Haus, übernehmen jedoch gemeinschaftlich akzeptierte Praktiken und Frameworks. Darüber hinaus geben wir der Community die Entwicklung eigener Tools in öffentlichen GitHub-Repositories zurück. Unser Ziel ist es, sicherzustellen, dass große Systeme die erwartete Leistung in der Praxis liefern, nicht nur auf dem Papier, indem Engpässe aufgedeckt und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen vorangetrieben werden.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are seeking highly skilled and motivated software engineers to join us and build AI inference systems that serve large-scale models with extreme efficiency. You’ll architect and implement high-performance inference stacks, optimize GPU kernels and compilers, drive industry benchmarks, and scale workloads across multi-GPU, multi-node, and multi-cloud environments. You’ll collaborate across inference, compiler, scheduling, and performance teams to push the frontier of accelerated computing for AI.

What you’ll be doing:

• Contribute features to vLLM that empower the newest models with the latest NVIDIA GPU hardware features; profile and optimize the inference framework (vLLM) with methods like speculative decoding, data/tensor/expert/pipeline-parallelism, prefill-decode disaggregation.

• Develop, optimize, and benchmark GPU kernels (hand-tuned and compiler-generated) using techniques such as fusion, autotuning, and memory/layout optimization; build and extend high-level DSLs and compiler infrastructure to boost kernel developer productivity while approaching peak hardware utilization.

• Define and build inference benchmarking methodologies and tools; contribute both new benchmark and NVIDIA’s submissions to the industry-leading MLPerf Inference benchmarking suite.

• Architect the scheduling and orchestration of containerized large-scale inference deployments on GPU clusters across clouds.

• Conduct and publish original research that pushes the pareto frontier for the field of ML Systems; survey recent publications and find a way to integrate research ideas and prototypes into NVIDIA’s software products.

What we need to see:

• Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent expeience) in Computer Science (CS), Computer Engineering (CE) or Software Engineering (SE) with 7+ years of experience; alternatively, Master’s degree in CS/CE/SE with 5+ years of experience; or PhD degree with the thesis and top-tier publications in ML Systems, GPU architecture, or high-performance computing.

• Strong programming skills in Python and C/C++; experience with Go or Rust is a plus; solid CS fundamentals: algorithms & data structures, operating systems, computer architecture, parallel programming, distributed systems, deep learning theories.

• Knowledgeable and passionate about performance engineering in ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and inference engines (e.g., vLLM and SGLang).

• Familiarity with GPU programming and performance: CUDA, memory hierarchy, streams, NCCL; proficiency with profiling/debug tools (e.g., Nsight Systems/Compute).

• Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Slurm); familiarity with Linux namespaces and cgroups.

• Excellent debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills; ability to excel in a fast-paced, multi-functional setting.

Ways to stand out from the crowd

• Experience building and optimizing LLM inference engines (e.g., vLLM, SGLang).

• Hands-on work with ML compilers and DSLs (e.g., Triton, TorchDynamo/Inductor, MLIR/LLVM, XLA), GPU libraries (e.g., CUTLASS) and features (e.g., CUDA Graph, Tensor Cores).

• Experience contributing to containerization/virtualization technologies such as containerd/CRI-O/CRIU.

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and production observability.

• Contributions to open-source projects and/or publications; please include links to GitHub pull requests, published papers and artifacts.

Our team consists of experts in AI, systems and performance optimization. descriptionByLocale.it:
Rinforzare l'apprendimento post-training sta guidando alcuni dei più significativi guadagni di capacità in AI oggi. È il processo che insegna un modello a ragionare attraverso problemi duri, seguire istruzioni complesse e agire come agente autonomo. È anche una delle sfide infrastrutturali più difficili del settore. RL richiede inferenza, generazione di rollout e formazione in esecuzione in un ciclo continuo. La fase di rollout è ciò che lo rende difficile: il modello deve interagire con ambienti, strumenti e altri modelli per produrre il segnale che spinge l'apprendimento. Coordinare attore, critico e premiare i modelli in hardware eterogeneo a scala spinge i limiti di ciò che i sistemi distribuiti possono fare. NVIDIA sta costruendo un team di ingegneri RL Frameworks per sviluppare gli strumenti open source e le infrastrutture a cui i ricercatori dell'IA e i team post-formazione dipendono. Il team abbraccia lo stack completo del software, collaborando a stretto contatto con i ricercatori e i laboratori che spingono la frontiera, per contribuire a framework RL come VeRL , Miles e TorchTitan , per migliorare i runtime distribuiti su cui dipendono, tra cui Ray e Monarch . Se la vostra forza sta lavorando con i ricercatori per capire e affrontare il loro bisogno di ottimizzare i quadri di apprendimento profondo, o costruire infrastrutture distribuite, vogliamo sentire da voi. Unisciti a noi per costruire i sistemi che permettono la prossima generazione di AI. Cosa farai: Architeggerai e costruirai infrastrutture di post-formazione RL che scalano in modo efficiente dalla sperimentazione su un singolo GPU alla produzione su migliaia di nodi. Ciò significa sintonizzare i loop RL di formazione-inferenza-rollout su GPU, CPU e LPU per le prestazioni in cui conta, contribuire a e migliorare le prestazioni e l'usabilità dei framework RL open-source e collaborare con i team che li possiedono. Il ruolo riguarda anche la tolleranza dei guasti, la scalatura elastica, e riavvia così i lavori di formazione distribuiti a lungo termine sopravvivono a guasti, stragglers, e la contention delle risorse. descriptionByLocale.en:
Reinforcement learning post-training is driving some of the most significant capability gains in AI today. It is the process that teaches a model to reason through hard problems, follow complex instructions, and act as an autonomous agent. It is also one of the hardest infrastructure challenges in the field. RL requires inference, rollout generation, and training running in a continuous loop. The rollout step is what makes it hard: the model must interact with environments, tools, and other models to produce the signal that drives learning. Coordinating actor, critic, and reward models across heterogeneous hardware at scale pushes the limits of what distributed systems can do.

NVIDIA is building an RL Frameworks engineering team to develop the open-source tools and infrastructure that AI researchers and post-training teams depend on. The team spans the full software stack, from collaborating closely with the researchers and labs pushing the frontier, to contributing to RL frameworks like VeRL , Miles , and TorchTitan , to improving the distributed runtimes they depend on, including Ray and Monarch . Whether your strength is working with researchers to understand and address their need optimizing deep learning frameworks, or building distributed infrastructure, we want to hear from you. Come join us to build the systems that enable the next generation of AI.

What you will be doing:
You will architect and build RL post-training infrastructure that scales efficiently from experimentation on a single GPU to production across thousands of nodes. This means tuning RL training-inference-rollout loops on GPUs, CPUs, and LPUs for performance where it matters, contributing to and improving the performance and usability of open-source RL frameworks, and partnering with the teams who own them. The role also spans fault tolerance, elastic scaling, and fast restarts so long-running distributed training jobs survive failures, stragglers, and resource contention.

Beyond GPU-accelerated training, this work includes partnering with teams building CPU-driven rollout workloads, including tool-use, code execution, and agentic environments, supplying the systems and framework engineering needed to run them efficiently alongside GPU- or LPU-accelerated generation and GPU-accelerated training. It also means advocating for researcher and partner needs with NVIDIA's networking, math library, and compiler teams so the capabilities RL workloads require get prioritized and delivered, and working with hardware teams to take advantage of next-generation hardware capabilities in post-training workloads.

What we need to see:

• MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

• 5+ years of professional experience in distributed systems, high-performance computing, deep learning infrastructure, or ML systems engineering

• Strong proficiency in Python and C/C++

• Demonstrated experience building or contributing to large-scale distributed systems or runtime frameworks in production at a frontier AI lab, hyperscaler, or major technology company

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate across organizational and geographic boundaries

Depth in one or more of the following technical areas:

• Reinforcement learning for LLM post-training (RLHF, PPO, GRPO, DPO, reward modeling), including how algorithms map to distributed execution and the systems challenges they create (heterogeneous placement, rollouts, environment execution, resharding between training and generation)

• PyTorch internals, including distributed training primitives (FSDP, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism) and their composition

• Kubernetes runtime internals (container lifecycle, pod scheduling, resource quotas, GPU allocation)

• End-to-end distributed systems design (service boundaries, data flows, consistency models, failure modes, recovery approaches)

Experience in any of the fol

Verstärkungslernen nach dem Training treibt heute einige der wichtigsten Fähigkeiten in der KI voran. Es ist der Prozess, der ein Modell lehrt, schwierige Probleme zu durchdenken, komplexen Anweisungen zu folgen und als autonomer Agent zu handeln. Es ist auch eine der schwierigsten Infrastrukturherausforderungen in diesem Bereich. RL erfordert Inferenz, Rollout-Generierung und Training in einer kontinuierlichen Schleife. Der Rollout-Schritt macht es schwierig: Das Modell muss mit Umgebungen, Tools und anderen Modellen interagieren, um das Signal zu erzeugen, das das Lernen antreibt. Die Koordination von Akteur-, Kritiker- und Belohnungsmodellen über heterogene Hardware in großem Maßstab erweitert die Grenzen dessen, was verteilte Systeme leisten können. NVIDIA baut ein RL Frameworks Engineering-Team auf, um die Open-Source-Tools und Infrastruktur zu entwickeln, auf die KI-Forscher und Post-Training-Teams angewiesen sind. Das Team umfasst den gesamten Software-Stack, von der engen Zusammenarbeit mit den Forschern und Labors, die die Grenze überschreiten, über den Beitrag zu RL-Frameworks wie VeRL, Miles und TorchTitan bis hin zur Verbesserung der verteilten Laufzeiten, von denen sie abhängen, einschließlich Ray und Monarch. Ob Ihre Stärke darin besteht, mit Forschern zusammenzuarbeiten, um ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und zu erfüllen, um Deep Learning-Frameworks zu optimieren oder eine verteilte Infrastruktur aufzubauen, möchten wir von Ihnen hören. Kommen Sie zu uns, um die Systeme zu bauen, die die nächste Generation von KI ermöglichen. Was Sie tun werden: Sie erstellen und bauen eine RL-Post-Training-Infrastruktur, die effizient vom Experimentieren mit einer einzigen GPU bis zur Produktion über Tausende von Knoten skaliert. Dies bedeutet, RL-Trainings-Inference-Rollout-Schleifen auf GPUs, CPUs und LPUs auf die Leistung abzustimmen, wo es darauf ankommt, zur Leistung und Benutzerfreundlichkeit von Open-Source-RL-Frameworks beizutragen und diese zu verbessern und mit den Teams zusammenzuarbeiten, die sie besitzen. Die Rolle umfasst auch Fehlertoleranz, elastische Skalierung und schnelle Neustarts, so dass lang laufende verteilte Trainingsaufträge Ausfälle, Nachzügler und Ressourcenkonflikte überleben. Neben dem GPU-beschleunigten Training umfasst diese Arbeit die Zusammenarbeit mit Teams, die CPU-gesteuerte Rollout-Workloads erstellen, einschließlich Tool-Use, Codeausführung und Agentic-Umgebungen, die Bereitstellung der Systeme und des Framework-Engineerings, die erforderlich sind, um sie effizient neben GPU- oder LPU-beschleunigter Generation und GPU-beschleunigtem Training auszuführen. Es bedeutet auch, sich für die Bedürfnisse von Forschern und Partnern mit NVIDIAs Netzwerk-, Mathematikbibliotheks- und Compilerteams einzusetzen, damit die Funktionen, die RL-Workloads erfordern, priorisiert und bereitgestellt werden, und mit Hardwareteams zusammenzuarbeiten, um die Vorteile der Hardwarefunktionen der nächsten Generation in Post-Training-Workloads zu nutzen. Le renforcement de l'apprentissage post-formation est à l'origine de certains des gains de capacité les plus importants dans l'IA aujourd'hui. C'est le processus qui enseigne un modèle à raisonner à travers des problèmes difficiles, suivre des instructions complexes, et agir comme un agent autonome. C'est aussi l'un des défis les plus difficiles en matière d'infrastructure sur le terrain. RL nécessite une inférence, une génération de déploiement et une formation en boucle continue. L'étape de déploiement est ce qui rend difficile: le modèle doit interagir avec les environnements, les outils et d'autres modèles pour produire le signal qui conduit à l'apprentissage. Coordonner les modèles d'acteur, de critique et de récompense sur des matériels hétérogènes à l'échelle pousse les limites de ce que les systèmes distribués peuvent faire. NVIDIA met sur pied une équipe d'ingénieurs RL Frameworks pour développer les outils et l'infrastructure open-source dont dépendent les chercheurs en IA et les équipes post-formation. L'équipe s'étend sur toute la pile de logiciels, de la collaboration étroite avec les chercheurs et les laboratoires poussant la frontière, à la contribution aux cadres RL comme VERL , Miles , et TorchTitan , à l'amélioration des temps d'exécution distribués dont ils dépendent, y compris Ray et Monarch . Que votre force travaille avec les chercheurs pour comprendre et répondre à leur besoin d'optimiser les cadres d'apprentissage profond, ou de construire une infrastructure distribuée, nous voulons vous entendre. Venez nous rejoindre pour construire les systèmes qui permettent la prochaine génération d'IA. Ce que vous ferez : Vous allez architecter et construire une infrastructure RL post-formation qui s'échelonne efficacement de l'expérimentation sur un seul GPU à la production à travers des milliers de nœuds. Il s'agit de mettre au point des boucles RL-inférence-rollout sur les GPU, les CPU et les LPU pour les performances où elles sont importantes, de contribuer et d'améliorer les performances et la facilité d'utilisation des cadres RL open-source, et de s'associer avec les équipes qui les possèdent. Le rôle s'étend également à la tolérance aux défauts, à l'échelle élastique et au redémarrage rapide si long terme des emplois d'entraînement répartis survivent aux échecs, aux pièges et aux disputes en matière de ressources. Au-delà de la formation accélérée par le GPU, ce travail comprend le partenariat avec des équipes qui construisent des charges de travail de déploiement entraînées par le CPU, y compris l'utilisation d'outils, l'exécution de codes et des environnements d'agents, fournissant les systèmes et l'ingénierie-cadre nécessaires pour les exécuter efficacement aux côtés de la génération accélérée par le GPU ou le LPU et de la formation accélérée par le GPU. Il s'agit aussi de défendre les besoins des chercheurs et des partenaires auprès des équipes de réseautage, de la bibliothèque de mathématiques et du compilateur de NVIDIA, de sorte que les capacités de charge de travail RL doivent être hiérarchisées et livrées, et de travailler avec les équipes de matériel pour tirer parti des capacités matérielles de nouvelle génération dans les charges de travail post-formation. Ce que nous devons voir :

• 5+ ans d'expérience professionnelle dans les systèmes distribués, l'informatique haute performance, l'infrastructure d'apprentissage profond ou l'ingénierie des systèmes ML
• Forte compétence en Python et en C/C++
• Expérience démontrée de la construction ou de la contribution à des systèmes distribués à grande échelle ou à des cadres d'exécution dans la production d'un laboratoire d'IA frontalier, d'un hyperéchelleur ou d'une entreprise technologique majeure
• Forte capacité de communication verbale et écrite et capacité de collaboration au-delà des frontières organisationnelles et géographiques Profondeur dans un ou plusieurs des domaines techniques suivants:
• Renforcement de l'apprentissage pour la formation post-formation LLM (RLHF, PPO, GRPO, DPO, modélisation de récompense), y compris la façon dont les algorithmes cartographient l'exécution distribuée et les défis des systèmes qu'ils créent (placement hétérogène, déploiement, exécution environnementale, résuration entre la formation et la génération)
• PyTorch internes, y compris l'entraînement distribué primitifs (FSDP, parallélisme tensor, parallélisme pipeline) et leur composition
• Kubernetes runtime internes (cycle de vie des conteneurs, programmation de pod, quotas de ressources, allocation de GPU)

descriptionByLocale.it:

• Competenza in Kubernetes e familiarità con i progetti CNCF correlati
• Sfondo di lavoro con sistemi basati su acceleratori paralleli e distribuiti su larga scala
• Competenza ottimizzando le prestazioni e i carichi di lavoro AI su sistemi su larga scala
• Esperienza con modellazione delle prestazioni e benchmarking su scala
• Proficienza in Golang/Python
• Sfondo con l'ecosistema software NVIDIA sia nei domini di formazione che di inferenza
• Competenza con almeno una delle infrastrutture CSP pubbliche (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI per esempio) Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:
• Forte esperienza operativa con una delle distribuzioni Kubernetes
• Esperienza precedente scalare cluster Kubernetes a nodo ultra-grande e conteggi oggetti
• Storia dimostrata di lavorare nella comunità open source
• Ottima comunicazione e capacità interpersonali
• PhD in aree rilevanti NVIDIA è ampiamente considerato uno dei datori di lavoro più desiderabili del mondo tecnologico. Abbiamo alcune delle persone più avanzate e laboriose al mondo che lavorano per noi. Se sei creativo e autonomo, vogliamo sentirti! La tua base
descriptionByLocale.en:

We're a team of innovative engineers dedicated to solving some of the world's biggest challenges, constantly driving advancements, and impacting millions of lives worldwide!

We are looking for an outstanding Systems Software Engineer with deep experience in distributed systems, open-source technologies such as Kubernetes and containers, and a strong background in systems performance and scalability. The ideal candidate brings broad, end-to-end experience across the stack - from GPU operator and device plugins to distributed inference serving and cloud platforms - along with the technical depth to investigate and address exciting, real-world problems at scale. In this pivotal role, you will take on the challenge of scaling AI infrastructure while optimizing total cost of ownership, driving down cost per token to unlock the next generation of AI innovation and AI factories!

What you'll be doing:

• Drive end-to-end performance and scale characterization for the NVIDIA DGX Cloud software stack, from Kubernetes control and data planes through NVIDIA components such as GPU Operator, Network Operator, DCGM, NIM, and distributed inference serving, following issues from orchestration down to the metal.

• Collaborate with AI researchers, developers and customers to develop innovative, automated tests that simulate real user workloads using custom-built and leading open-source tools and frameworks.

• Deep dive into performance and scale issues in complex distributed systems, including interactions between Kubernetes and the NVIDIA software stack, to identify and resolve root causes.

• Design and develop monitoring, reporting and analysis tools for performance and scale testing across software, GPU and CPU resources.

• Triage, debug and root cause issues related to operating Kubernetes clusters at ultra-large scale, ensuring reliability and efficiency.

• Build and maintain a high-velocity framework that enables continuous, always-on performance and scale testing via a modern CI/CD pipeline.

• Document research, methodologies and results clearly and concisely, and present findings at internal and external venues, including community conferences such as KubeCon and GTC.

• Engage efficiently with upstream communities — including Kubernetes, CNCF and NVIDIA open-source projects — to validate performance and scalability of AI workloads early and help shape design and development decisions.

What we need to see:

• 2+ years of experience Computer Architecture, Networking, Storage systems, Accelerators and Bachelors/Masters in Engineering (preferably, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science) or equivalent experience

• Expertise in Kubernetes and familiarity with related CNCF projects

• Background in working with large scale parallel and distributed accelerator-based systems

• Expertise optimizing performance and AI workloads on large scale systems

• Experience with performance modeling and benchmarking at scale

• Proficiency in Golang/Python

• Background with the NVIDIA software ecosystem in both training and inference domains

• Expertise with at least one of public CSP infrastructure (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI for example)

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Strong operational experience with any one of the Kubernetes distributions

• Prior experience scaling Kubernetes clusters to ultra-large node and object counts

• Demonstrated history of working in the open-source community

• Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities

• PhD in relevant areas

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

title: Senior Network Software Validation Engineer – AI Clusters

titleByLocale.it: Senior Network Software Validation Ingegnere – AI Clusters
titleByLocale.en: Senior Network Software Validation Engineer – AI Clusters
titleByLocale.de: Senior Network Software Validation Ingenieur – AI Clusters
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Network Software Validation Ingénieur – AI Clusters

descriptionByLocale.en:
NVIDIA is the world leader in accelerated computing, powering the AI revolution across the world's largest data centers, clouds, and supercomputers. Within NVIDIA, the Networking Business Unit (NBU) builds the high-speed interconnect—including Ethernet, InfiniBand, NVLink, and BlueField DPUs—that connects thousands of GPUs into a single AI supercomputer, moving data at the scale and speed required by the world's most demanding AI workloads.

NVIDIA is looking for a Senior Network Software Validation Engineer to join our Network Cluster Solutions (NCS) Validation group. You will work on validating advanced networking solutions across complex NVIDIA AI cluster environments. The group is a high-performance engineering force that treats validation as a first-class software problem. We build systems, frameworks, and benchmarks that prove the correctness, reliability, and performance of NVIDIA networking solutions at scale. This role combines the development of validation methodologies and automation tools with hands-on debugging, performance analysis, and investigation of cutting-edge AI networking technologies at scale.

What You'll be Doing:

• Design validation methodologies, review product requirements, and develop comprehensive test plans for networking technologies in large-scale AI cluster solutions.

• Develop and maintain automation tools and scripts for test execution, environment setup, log collection, and data analysis.

• Execute functional, regression, performance, scale, and reliability testing across networking and AI cluster solutions.

• Own end-to-end investigation of complex customer issues by reproducing real-world scenarios, analyzing logs, telemetry, packet captures, and system metrics to identify functional issues and performance bottlenecks, triaging problems across the hardware and software stack, and driving them to root cause and resolution.

• Read and understand source code (C/C++/Python) to investigate defects, validate fixes, and improve logging, instrumentation, and debugging capabilities.

• Collaborate closely with software and hardware development teams to debug networking technologies, including NCCL, RoCE, RDMA, and related software components using targeted experiments and code inspection.

• Profile and benchmark AI training and inference workloads, correlating application behavior with network and system telemetry to identify scalability and performance limitations.

• Document findings, communicate technical results, and continuously improve validation methodologies, automation, and engineering processes.

What we need to see:

• B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8+ years of hands-on experience in networking, system validation, software testing, or system-level debugging on Linux.

• Strong Linux systems knowledge and networking debugging experience in scale.

• Proven experience debugging complex production systems by forming hypotheses, designing experiments, and driving issues to root cause.

• Ability to read and reason about source code and collaborate closely with development teams to validate fixes.

• Strong scripting and automation experience using Python, Bash, and/or Ansible.

• Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills with a strong sense of ownership.

• Fast learner with curiosity for AI infrastructure, distributed systems, and modern AI-assisted engineering tools.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

• Strong knowledge of AI networking technologies including NCCL, RoCE, and RDMA, with experience debugging both correctness and performance issues at scale.

• Deep understanding of congestion control and lossless Ethernet technologies for AI workloads, including DCQCN, ECN, and PFC.

• Experience debugging issues spanning multiple layers, including networking (L2/L3), transport protocols, operating systems, AI frameworks, and distributed

descriptionByLocale.it:

Stiamo cercando un ingegnere software per unire il nostro team per sviluppare strumenti di simulazione costruiti per scienziati e aziende che stanno utilizzando machine learning per risolvere il futuro della robotica. Ti unirai a un team di ingegneri robotici che lavorano all'incrocio tra simulazione e machine learning. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di costruire lo strumento leader del settore per la valutazione dei modelli di fondazione robot in simulazione. Questa missione si basa sulla storia di NVIDIA di creare mondi virtuali utilizzando la sua tecnologia innovativa sulle tecnologie di rendering fotorealistico e simulazione fisica.

Cosa dobbiamo vedere:

• MSc, grado di dottorato o equivalente in Informatica, Robotica, o un campo correlato.

• 3+ anni di esperienza nella robotica e/o nella simulazione.

• Esperienza nella progettazione del software e lavoro su un progetto software significativo.

descriptionByLocale.en:
In the NVIDIA Isaac team, we build tools that bring the power of the GPU to bear on one of today’s grand challenges: physical AI. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, encouraging environment where we all work together to advance the frontiers of accelerated computing.

We’re looking for a software engineer to join our team to develop simulation tools built for scientists and companies that are using machine learning to solve the future of robotics. You'll join a team of robotics engineers who work at the intersection of simulation and machine learning. Our goal is to build the industry's leading tool for evaluating robot foundation models in simulation. This mission builds on NVIDIA's history of creating virtual worlds using its groundbreaking technology on photorealistic rendering and physics simulation technologies.

What you'll be doing:

• Building simulation frameworks for training and evaluating robot foundation models on top of NVIDIA's Omniverse platform.

• Working as part of a high-paced software engineering team: design/code reviews, testing, continuous integration, deployment.

• Training and evaluating robot foundation models.

• Integrating modern LLM and agentic workflows into simulation and robotics workflows.

• Working with researchers to translate ideas from research into products that can scale to NVIDIA's user base.

• Keeping up to date with the state-of-the-art in robotics research.

What we need to see:

• MSc, PhD degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in robotics and/or simulation.

• Experience in software design and working on a significant software project.

• Proficiency using Python and development experience with deep learning software stacks (Pytorch, Jax, etc.).

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Publications and/or projects that demonstrate excellence in moving the needle in the field of robotics.

• Robot learning expertise with reinforcement learning and/or imitation learning,

• Physics simulation expertise.

• Experience with tools used in the NVIDIA robotics ecosystem (CUDA, warp, Isaac Lab, ROS).

• Developing and maintaining open-source projects.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join NVIDIA's world-class team as a Robotics Software Engineer - Sim-to-Real in Zurich, Switzerland, and be part of the ambitious journey to redefine the future of robotics! You will work on groundbreaking projects that transform advancements in simulation into real-world applications, making a significant impact on both our technology and the world.

What you'll be doing:

• Lead the forefront of Physical AI progress in both simulated and real humanoid robots by building the humanoid reference platform that features NVIDIA's robotics technologies.

• Work together with various groups to seamlessly incorporate NVIDIA robotics products like Jetson Thor, Isaac Sim/Lab, Isaac ROS into all-encompassing solutions for humanoid robots.

• Work on making things function seamlessly on real robots in our Zurich lab, focusing on training and deploying whole-body controllers, manipulation policies (VLA/WAM) and embedded agents (CaP).

What we need to see:

• 5 years of experience in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, or a related field, with proven experience in the industry.

• Proficiency in C++ and Python programming languages and experience applying them to real-time robotics systems.

• Hands-on experience with both simulated and physical robots.

• In-depth knowledge of tools and libraries for robotics and learning, including PyTorch, ROS2, and physics simulators like Isaac Sim or Newton.

• Experience with learning-based robotics such as sim-to-real RL training, VLA fine-tuning, or embedded/code-as-policy agents.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Proven experience using NVIDIA robotics tools (Isaac Sim/Lab, Isaac ROS, Isaac GR00T) and hardware (Jetson platform).

• Practical experience handling humanoid robots in a commercial or academic setting.

• Extensive hands-on experience with robotic systems that demonstrate your ability to effectively apply complex solutions.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

• 8+ years of hands‑on networking or system‑level testing and debugging on Linux.

• Proven production‑grade debugging experience: forming hypotheses, running experiments, and driving issues to root cause under pressure.

• Expertise in host‑side NIC validation and tuning (offloads, queues, interrupts, firmware/driver interactions).

descriptionByLocale.it:

Poiché la simulazione diventa fondamentale per la robotica e l'automazione industriale, le richieste di fedeltà fisica stanno aumentando rapidamente. Automotive, aerospaziale, manifatturiera e robotica richiedono simulazioni che vanno oltre plausibilità visiva e raggiungono precisione predittiva di livello ingegneristico. Siamo alla ricerca di un leader tecnico senior che possa aumentare la fedeltà, la robustezza e il valore pratico del nostro stack di simulazione ingegneristica per robotica, automazione e gemelle digitali industriali. Piuttosto che puntare sulla plausibilità visiva, questo è un ruolo per qualcuno che ha già costruito la tecnologia di simulazione utilizzata per prendere decisioni su macchine reali: robot, attrezzature industriali, veicoli, assemblaggi flessibili, o altri sistemi elettromeccanici complessi. Si dovrebbe essere comodo trasformare ambiguo comportamento del mondo reale in modelli trattabili, scegliendo il giusto livello di fedeltà per il problema, convalidando quei modelli contro i dati, e guidando l'implementazione di qualità della produzione in un moderno agente AI basato ambiente accelerato-computing. In questo ruolo, si contribuirà a definire e implementare la prossima generazione di funzionalità di simulazione ad alta fedeltà attraverso la robotica e lo stack di simulazione industriale di NVIDIA. Potrai lavorare su problemi meccanici difficili che importano nel mondo reale, tra cui macchine articolate, interazioni ricche di contatti, sistemi di attrito, componenti deformabili o conformi, e elementi flessibili come cavi, fili, dresspack, o assemblaggi imbrigliati. descriptionByLocale.en:
At NVIDIA, we build the simulation technologies powering the future of robotics, industrial AI, autonomous systems, and digital twins.

NVIDIA Omniverse simulation technologies are used to power reinforcement learning systems, train robots, simulate factories and warehouses, and enable physically accurate digital twins.
As simulation becomes foundational to robotics and industrial automation, the demands on physical fidelity are rapidly increasing. Automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, and robotics require simulations that go beyond visual plausibility and reach engineering-grade predictive accuracy.
We are looking for a senior technical leader who can raise the fidelity, robustness, and practical value of our engineering simulation stack for robotics, automation, and industrial digital twins. Rather than focusing on visual plausibility, this is a role for someone who has already built simulation technology used to make decisions about real machines: robots, industrial equipment, vehicles, flexible assemblies, or other complex electromechanical systems. You should be comfortable turning ambiguous real-world behavior into tractable models, choosing the right level of fidelity for the problem, validating those models against data, and driving production-quality implementation in a modern agentic AI based accelerated-computing environment.

In this role, you will help define and implement the next generation of high-fidelity simulation capabilities across NVIDIA’s robotics and industrial simulation stack. You will work on difficult mechanics problems that matter in the real world, including articulated machines, contact-rich interactions, frictional systems, deformable or compliant components, and flexible elements such as cables, wires, dresspacks, or harness-like assemblies. You will collaborate closely with teams across physics, robotics, digital twins, controls, and GPU software to turn advanced simulation methods into scalable developer and product capabilities.

What you’ll be doing:

• Design and develop advanced physically based simulation systems for robotics and industrial digital twins.

• Collaborate with teams across PhysX, Newton, Omniverse, and Isaac robotics.

• Bring modern industrial and engineering simulation methodologies into NVIDIA’s scalable simulation stack.

• Design, evaluate and improve methods for multibody dynamics, contact and friction, flexible-body behavior, deformables, and related numerical solvers.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez NVIDIA, nous construisons les technologies de simulation qui alimentent l'avenir de la robotique, de l'IA industrielle, des systèmes autonomes et des jumeaux numériques. NVIDIA Les technologies de simulation Omniverse sont utilisées pour alimenter les systèmes d'apprentissage du renforcement, former des robots, simuler des usines et des entrepôts, et permettre des jumeaux numériques physiquement précis. À mesure que la simulation devient fondamentale pour la robotique et l'automatisation industrielle, les exigences en matière de fidélité physique augmentent rapidement. L'automobile, l'aérospatiale, la fabrication et la robotique nécessitent des simulations qui vont au-delà de la plausibilité visuelle et atteignent la précision prédictive de qualité technique. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader technique senior qui peut augmenter la fidélité, la robustesse et la valeur pratique de notre pile de simulation d'ingénierie pour la robotique, l'automatisation et les jumelles numériques industrielles. Plutôt que de se concentrer sur la plausibilité visuelle, c'est un rôle pour quelqu'un qui a déjà construit la technologie de simulation utilisée pour prendre des décisions sur les machines réelles : robots, équipements industriels, véhicules, assemblages flexibles, ou d'autres systèmes électromécaniques complexes. Vous devriez être à l'aise de transformer un comportement ambigu dans le monde réel en modèles traçables, en choisissant le bon niveau de fidélité pour le problème, en validant ces modèles contre les données, et en conduisant l'implémentation de qualité de production dans un environnement moderne de calcul accéléré basé sur l'IA. Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez à définir et à mettre en œuvre la prochaine génération de capacités de simulation haute fidélité à travers la robotique NVIDIA et la pile de simulation industrielle. Vous travaillerez sur des problèmes de mécanique difficiles qui comptent dans le monde réel, y compris des machines articulées, des interactions riches en contacts, des systèmes de friction, des composants déformables ou conformes, et des éléments flexibles tels que des câbles, des fils, des dresspacks ou des assemblages de type harnais. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de la physique, de la robotique, des jumeaux numériques, des commandes et des logiciels GPU pour transformer les méthodes de simulation avancées en capacités de développement et de produit évolutives. Ce que vous allez faire:
• Concevoir et développer des systèmes avancés de simulation physique pour la robotique et les jumelles numériques industrielles.
• Collaborer avec des équipes de PhysX, Newton, Omniverse et Isaac robotique.
• Apportez des méthodologies modernes de simulation industrielle et d'ingénierie dans la pile de simulation évolutive NVIDIA.
• Concevoir, évaluer et améliorer les méthodes pour la dynamique multicorps, le contact et la friction, le comportement du corps flexible, les déformables et les résolveurs numériques connexes.
• Intégrer la simulation avec des flux de travail robotiques impliquant des pipelines ROS 2, CAO et URDF, des actifs OpenUSD, des environnements HIL/SIL et des boucles de développement de contrôleurs.
• Aider GPU à accélérer les implémentations et à sortir des algorithmes de simulation avancés.
• Mentor ingénieurs et de contribuer au leadership technique dans toute l'organisation! Ce que nous devons voir :
• Une expérience de construction ou de premier logiciel de simulation utilisé dans les domaines de l'ingénierie de production, de la robotique, des machines industrielles, de l'automobile, de l'aérospatiale, de la fabrication ou des domaines adjacents.
• 15 ans et plus d'expérience pertinente de l'industrie, démontrant un impact soutenu sur le développement de simulations, la conception de systèmes ou les logiciels d'ingénierie à l'échelle.
• Maîtrise ou doctorat dans une discipline pertinente (p. ex. génie mécanique, robotique, informatique, mathématiques appliquées ou physique), ou une expertise équivalente grâce à l'expérience professionnelle
• Connaissance approfondie dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : dynamique multicorps, systèmes limités, contact et frottement, articulations, corps flexibles, simulation de câbles ou de fils, déformables, FEM, conception de solveur, intégration numérique, manutention de la rigidité ou réduction du modèle.
• Expérience de validation des simulateurs par rapport aux systèmes physiques, y compris une combinaison de corrélation de test, d'étalonnage, de flux de travail HIL/SIL, ou de co-simulation de contrôleur.
• Capacité de travail dans les chaînes d'outils d'intégration de systèmes robotiques et d'ingénierie mécanique, y compris ROS 2, Simulink, Simscape et les pipelines modèles basés sur CAO, URDF, MJCF ou OpenU
