descriptionByLocale.en:
At NVIDIA, we are advancing healthcare through innovation. As a Senior Solutions Architect for Medical Devices, you will collaborate with medical device customers, developers, scientists, and academic and industry leaders across EMEA to harness AI and accelerated computing.
NVIDIA’s Solution Architects are developers and scientists who apply the latest AI and accelerated computing technologies. Our machine learning, deep learning, and high-performance computing platforms are widely adopted across healthcare, including by medical device manufacturers, academic medical centers, pharmaceutical companies, and startups.
In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers integrate AI and accelerated computing at the edge and in the cloud. You will develop proof-of-concept demonstrations, build strategic executive relationships, and work with developers, researchers, data scientists, and IT leaders on impactful healthcare projects.
The ideal candidate is passionate about AI and accelerated computing in medical devices, has several years of medical device industry experience across research, technical project leadership, and product development, and enjoys cutting-edge technology and continuous learning.

What you will be doing:

• Partner with our business/account team working with customers to develop a keen understanding of their goals, strategies, and technical needs and to help define and deliver high-value solutions meeting these needs.

• Work to design NVIDIA's HW/SW into next-generation software-defined medical devices, AI-enabled clinical applications, and advanced healthcare product platforms.

• Stay up to date on the state of the art in medical image analysis, sensor processing, clinical AI, digital health, and surgical data science to apply the latest advancements in the field to customer needs.

• Support customers to optimize workloads using NVIDIA’s computing platform.

• Document what you know and teach others. This can vary from building targeted training for partners and other Solutions Architects, to writing whitepapers, blogs, and wiki articles, to simply working through hard problems with a customer on a whiteboard.

• Partner strategically with lighthouse customers and industry-specific solution partners targeting our computing platform.

• We make heavy use of conferencing tools, but some travel is required for this role. You are empowered to find the best way to get your job done and make our customers successful.

What we need to see:

• Strong foundational expertise: MS, PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Mathematics, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or closely related fields.

• 5+ years of work-related experience in software development, machine learning, deep learning or high-performance computing.

• In-depth knowledge and practical experience with contemporary Deep Learning software architecture and frameworks, in particular regarding image and video processing of medical and surgical modalities.

• Experience in scientific computing and software development with C/C++, Python, or CUDA. Skilled in streaming data processing, performance analysis, and optimization from algorithms to pipelines.

• Strong time-management and organizational skills for coordinating multiple initiatives, priorities, and implementations of new technology and products into very complex projects.

• Excellent communication skills particularly in the presentation of highly technical material. Must enjoy interacting with forward-thinking people, life-long learning, and staying at the forefront of the domain.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Domain expertise and proven hands-on experience applying accelerated computing and AI in one or more medical device areas, such as medical imaging, digital surgery, surgical data science, image-guided intervention, patient monitoring, or clinical workflow applications. Familiarity with clinical workflows, interventional

descriptionByLocale.en:
NVIDIA is leading groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU -- our invention -- serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables groundbreaking creativity and discovery, and powers inventions that were once considered science fiction, including artificial intelligence to autonomous cars.

What we are seeking:
Come work for the team that brought to you NCCL, NVSHMEM & GPUDirect. Our GPU communication libraries are crucial for scaling Deep Learning and HPC applications! We're seeking a Senior Software Architect to help co-design next-gen data center platforms and scalable communications software.

DL and HPC applications have a huge compute demands and already run at scales of up to tens of thousands of GPUs. GPUs are connected with high-speed interconnects (e.g. NVLink, PCIe) within a node and with high-speed networking (e.g. InfiniBand, Ethernet) across nodes. Efficient and fast communication between GPUs directly impacts end-to-end application performance. This impact continues to grow with the increasing scale of next generation systems. This is an outstanding opportunity to advance the state-of-the-art, break performance barriers, and deliver platforms the world has never seen before. Are you ready to build the new and innovative technologies that will help realize NVIDIA's vision?

What you will be doing:

• Investigate opportunities to improve communication performance by identifying bottlenecks in today's systems.

• Design and implement new communication technologies to accelerate AI and HPC workloads.

• Explore innovative solutions in HW and SW for our next generation platforms as part of co-design efforts involving GPU, Networking, and SW architects.

• Build proofs-of-concept, conduct experiments, and perform quantitive modeling to evaluate and drive new innovations.

• Use simulation to explore performance of large GPU clusters (think scales of 100s of 1000s of GPUs)

What we need to see:

• M.S./Ph.D. degree in CS/CE or equivalent experience.

• 3+ years of relevant experience.

• Excellent C/C++ programming and debugging skills.

• Experience with parallel programming models (MPI, SHMEM) and at least one communication runtime (MPI, NCCL, NVSHMEM, OpenSHMEM, UCX, UCC).

• Deep understanding of operating systems, computer and system architecture.

• Solid in fundamentals of network architecture, topology, algorithms, and communication scaling relevant to AI and HPC workloads.

• Strong experience with Linux.

• Ability and flexibility to work and communicate effectively in a multi-national, multi-time-zone corporate environment.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Expertise in related technology and passion for what you do. Experience with CUDA programming and NVIDIA GPUs. Knowledge of high-performance networks like InfiniBand, RoCE, NVLink, etc.

• Experience with Deep Learning Frameworks such PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc. Knowledge of deep learning parallelisms and mapping to the communication subsystem. Experience with HPC applications.

• Strong collaborative and interpersonal skills and a proven track record of effectively guiding and influencing within a dynamic and multi-functional environment.

NVIDIA is at the forefront of breakthroughs in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Our teams are composed of driven, innovative professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology. We offer highly competitive salaries, an extensive benefits package, and a work environment that promotes diversity, inclusion, and flexibility. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a supportive and empowering workplace for all.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. For Poland: The base salary range is 221,250

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di ridefinire come il mondo crea, consuma e analizza i contenuti video? In questo ruolo, aiuterai le principali organizzazioni ISV e M&E a costruire piattaforme AI che portino l'intelligenza ad ogni frame, dall'analisi video in tempo reale e dalla sintesi automatizzata alla generazione di contenuti di marketing basati su AI che fonde beni 2D e 3D. Potrai combinare la tua profonda esperienza nel rilevamento, monitoraggio e generazione di contenuti alimentato da AI con le principali piattaforme GPU e AI di NVIDIA. Questo ruolo mira a guidare un impatto misurabile su ecosistemi multimediali globali. Abbiamo bisogno di un individuo creativo e pratico per aiutare i nostri partner a navigare le sfide di implementare modelli all'avanguardia in scala, sia su dispositivi Edge per analisi in tempo reale o attraverso le implementazioni di Large Cloud per una gestione massiccia dei contenuti. Cosa farai:
• Lavorerai sul nostro EMEA M&E Solution Architects Team per guidare l'adozione della tecnologia NVIDIA nei principali clienti M&E. Potrai proteggere le costruzioni in Data Center, Edge e Cloud Deployments.
• Diventa un consulente tecnico di fiducia per i nostri clienti basati su EMEA, aiutandoli ad architetto end-to-end agentic pipelines come analisi video, analisi di archivio e e estrazione automatizzata dei metadati, ecc...
• Condurre le prove dei clienti (PoC) utilizzando piattaforme AI di nuova generazione per risolvere complessi casi di utilizzo M&E, tra cui la sintesi video automatizzata, i flussi di lavoro di agentic e Generative AI per la sintesi di immagini e video.
• Progettare e implementare soluzioni scalabili di inferenza che gestiscono la transizione dall'elaborazione Edge a cluster cloud di massa, affrontando le sfide di throughput e latenza uniche dei modelli VLM e Diffusion.
• Partner di NVIDIA Engineering, Product e Sales team per ottimizzare algoritmi e sistemi di bridging delle tecniche AI, fornendo feedback critici sul campo per influenzare il futuro software M&E e le roadmap hardware di NVIDIA.
• Adottare le Piattaforme Compute Accelerated di NVIDIA, concentrandosi sulla crescita delle capacità dei nostri clienti nell’implementazione di architetture AI moderne, dalle CNN tradizionali ai modelli generativi basati sui trasformatori. Cosa dobbiamo vedere:
• MS o PhD in Informatica, Computer Vision, Ingegneria, o relativo campo tecnico (o esperienza equivalente).
• 5+ anni di esperienza in Computer Vision, con una solida base negli algoritmi di rilevamento, segmentazione e monitoraggio tradizionali.
• Modelli di Vision Language (VLM) e/o modelli di AI Generativi applicati alla creazione di contenuti visivi e video (ad esempio, Diffusione stabile, GAN o Sintesi basata su Transformer).
• Proficienza con framework ML come PyTorch e una profonda comprensione delle sfide coinvolte nella distribuzione del modello, personalizzazione, quantizzazione e inferenza su scala.
• Gestire i carichi di lavoro AI in ambienti diversi, dai dispositivi Edge basati sulle risorse alle infrastrutture Cloud ad alte prestazioni.
• Ottima capacità di presentazione con la capacità di colmare il divario tra profonde discussioni tecniche con gli ingegneri e conversazioni basate sul valore con i dirigenti. Modi per allontanarsi dalla folla:
• Competenza con SDK specifici per NVIDIA, come DeepStream, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, TAO e i framework Holoscan o NeMo.
• Esperienza con rendering 3D, illuminazione o familiarità con strumenti di creazione scene come NVIDIA Omniverse.
• Sfondo forte nella containerizzazione (Docker/K8s) e ottimizzando l'inferenza distribuita per i modelli di grande visione. Abbiamo alcune delle persone più avanzate e dedicate al mondo che lavorano per noi. Se sei creativo e autonomo, vogliamo sentirti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you passionate about redefining how the world creates, consumes, and analyzes video content? We are looking for a Solutions Architect to join NVIDIA’s EMEA Media & Entertainment (M&E) Team, focusing on the intersection of traditional Computer Vision and the frontier of Generative AI. In this role, you will help leading ISVs and M&E organizations build AI platforms that bring intelligence to every frame—from real-time video analytics and automated summarization to AI-driven marketing content generation that blends 2D and 3D assets.

You will combine your deep expertise in detection, tracking, and content generation powered by AI with NVIDIA’s top GPU and AI platforms. This role aims to drive measurable impact across global media ecosystems. We need a creative, hands-on individual to help our partners navigate the challenges of deploying state-of-the-art models at scale, whether on Edge devices for real-time analysis or across Large Cloud deployments for massive content management.

What you will be doing:

• You will work on our EMEA M&E Solution Architects Team to drive NVIDIA technology adoption at key M&E customers. You will secure builds in Data Center, Edge, and Cloud Deployments.

• Become a trusted technical advisor for our EMEA-based customers, helping them architect end-to-end agentic pipelines like video analytics, archive analysis, and automated metadata extraction, etc…

• Lead customer proof-of-concepts (PoCs) using next-generation AI platforms to solve complex M&E use cases, including automated video summarization, agentic and Generative AI workflows for image and video synthesis.

• Design and implement scalable inference solutions that manage the transition from Edge-based processing to massive Cloud clusters, addressing the unique throughput and latency challenges of VLMs and Diffusion models.

• Partner with NVIDIA Engineering, Product, and Sales teams to optimize AI techniques bridging algorithms and systems, providing critical field feedback to influence NVIDIA’s future M&E software and hardware roadmaps.

• Drive adoption of NVIDIA’s Accelerated Compute Platforms, focusing on growing our customers’ capabilities in deploying modern AI architectures, from traditional CNNs to transformer-based generative models.

What We Need to See:

• MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent experience).

• 5+ years of experience in Computer Vision, with a strong foundation in traditional Detection, Segmentation, and Tracking algorithms.

• Hands-on experience developing or implementing Vision Language Models (VLMs) and/or Generative AI models applied to visual and video content creation (e.g., Stable Diffusion, GANs, or Transformer-based synthesis).

• Proficiency with ML frameworks like PyTorch and a deep understanding of the challenges involved in model deployment, customization, quantization and inference at scale.

• Experience managing AI workloads across diverse environments, from resource-constrained Edge devices to high-performance Cloud infrastructure.

• Excellent presentation skills with the ability to bridge the gap between deep technical discussions with engineers and value-based conversations with executives.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

• Expertise with NVIDIA-specific SDKs such as DeepStream, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, TAO, and the Holoscan or NeMo frameworks.

• Experience with 3D rendering, lighting or familiarity with scene creation tools like NVIDIA Omniverse.

• Strong background in containerization (Docker/K8s) and optimizing distributed inference for Large Vision Models.

We have some of the most forward-thinking and dedicated people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you.

• Werden Sie ein zuverlässiger technischer Berater für unsere EMEA-Kunden und helfen Sie ihnen, durchgängige agentische Pipelines wie Videoanalyse, Archivanalyse und automatisierte Metadatenextraktion usw. zu erstellen.
• Führen Sie Customer Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) mithilfe von KI-Plattformen der nächsten Generation, um komplexe M & E-Anwendungsfälle zu lösen, einschließlich automatisierter Videozusammenfassung, agentischer und generativer KI-Workflows für die Bild- und Videosynthese.
• Konzipieren und implementieren Sie skalierbare Inferenzlösungen, die den Übergang von Edge-basierter Verarbeitung zu massiven Cloud-Clustern verwalten und die einzigartigen Durchsatz- und Latenzherausforderungen von VLMs und Diffusionsmodellen bewältigen.
• Partnerschaft mit NVIDIA Engineering-, Produkt- und Vertriebsteams zur Optimierung von KI-Techniken, die Algorithmen und Systeme überbrücken und kritisches Feldfeedback bereitstellen, um die zukünftigen M & E-Software- und Hardware-Roadmaps von NVIDIA zu beeinflussen.
• Fördern Sie die Einführung von NVIDIAs Accelerated Compute Platforms und konzentrieren Sie sich auf die Erweiterung der Fähigkeiten unserer Kunden bei der Bereitstellung moderner KI-Architekturen, von traditionellen CNNs bis hin zu transformatorbasierten Generativmodellen. Was wir sehen müssen:
• MS oder PhD in Informatik, Computer Vision, Engineering oder verwandten technischen Bereich (oder gleichwertige Erfahrung).
• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in Computer Vision, mit einer starken Grundlage in traditionellen Erkennungs-, Segmentierungs- und Tracking-Algorithmen.
• Praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung oder Implementierung von Vision Language Models (VLMs) und/oder Generative AI-Modellen für die Erstellung von visuellen und Videoinhalten (z. B. Stable Diffusion, GANs oder Transformer-basierte Synthese).
• Kenntnisse mit ML-Frameworks wie PyTorch und ein tiefes Verständnis der Herausforderungen bei der Modellbereitstellung, Anpassung, Quantisierung und Inferenz im Maßstab.
• Erleben Sie die Verwaltung von KI-Workloads in verschiedenen Umgebungen, von ressourcenbeschränkten Edge-Geräten bis hin zu einer leistungsstarken Cloud-Infrastruktur.
• Hervorragende Präsentationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, die Lücke zwischen tiefen technischen Diskussionen mit Ingenieuren und wertorientierten Gesprächen mit Führungskräften zu schließen. Möglichkeiten, sich von der Masse abzuheben:
• Expertise mit NVIDIA-spezifischen SDKs wie DeepStream, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, TAO und den Holoscan- oder NeMo-Frameworks.
• Erfahrung mit 3D-Rendering, Beleuchtung oder Vertrautheit mit Tools zur Erstellung von Szenen wie NVIDIA Omniverse.
• Starker Hintergrund in der Containerisierung (Docker/K8s) und der Optimierung der verteilten Inferenz für Large Vision Modelle. Wir haben einige der fortschrittlichsten und engagiertesten Menschen der Welt, die für uns arbeiten. Wenn Sie kreativ und autonom sind, möchten wir von Ihnen hören.

Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez à diriger les VSI et les organisations de M&E à construire des plates-formes d'IA qui apportent de l'intelligence à chaque cadre, depuis l'analyse vidéo en temps réel et la synthèse automatisée jusqu'à la génération de contenu marketing pilotée par l'IA qui combine les actifs 2D et 3D. Vous combinerez votre expertise approfondie dans la détection, le suivi et la génération de contenu alimentés par l'IA avec les plateformes GPU et AI NVIDIA. Ce rôle vise à susciter des impacts mesurables dans les écosystèmes des médias mondiaux. Nous avons besoin d'un individu créatif et pratique pour aider nos partenaires à parcourir les défis du déploiement de modèles de pointe à l'échelle, que ce soit sur les appareils Edge pour l'analyse en temps réel ou sur les déploiements Large Cloud pour une gestion massive du contenu. Ce que vous ferez :
• Vous travaillerez sur notre équipe d'architectes de solutions de M&E de l'EMEA pour conduire l'adoption de la technologie NVIDIA chez les clients clés de M&E. Vous sécuriserez les constructions dans Data Center, Edge et Cloud Deployments.

• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions d'inférence évolutives qui gèrent la transition du traitement basé sur Edge à des clusters Cloud massifs, en répondant aux défis uniques de débit et de latence des modèles VLM et Diffusion.

• MS ou doctorat en informatique, vision informatique, génie ou domaine technique connexe (ou expérience équivalente).
• 5+ ans d'expérience dans la vision informatique, avec une base solide dans les algorithmes traditionnels de détection, de segmentation et de suivi.
• Expérience pratique du développement ou de la mise en œuvre de modèles de langage de vision (VLM) et/ou de modèles d'IA génériques appliqués à la création de contenu visuel et vidéo (p. ex. diffusion stable, GAN ou synthèse basée sur Transformer).

• Expérimentez la gestion de la charge de travail en matière d'IA dans divers environnements, depuis les appareils Edge bloqués par les ressources jusqu'à l'infrastructure Cloud haute performance.

• Expertise avec des SDK spécifiques à NVIDIA tels que DeepStream, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, TAO, et les cadres Holoscan ou NeMo.
• Expérience avec le rendu 3D, l'éclairage ou la familiarité avec des outils de création de scène comme NVIDIA Omniverse.

descriptionByLocale.it:
OmniDreams e FlashDreams di NVIDIA sono la base per una nuova generazione di sistemi interattivi di modellazione mondiale. Con questa release, NVIDIA ha stabilito lo standard per la fedeltà, prestazioni in tempo reale di inferenza nei modelli mondiali. E, abbiamo messo il nostro lavoro all'aperto con un rilascio di modelli di pesi aperti con un motore di infezione open source associato. Siamo in missione di continuare a sollevare quella barra, rendendo i modelli interattivi del mondo realizzabili ovunque i mondi dinamici siano importanti: veicoli autonomi, robotica, rendering e simulazione. Stiamo cercando un leader di ingegneria per trasformare questa tecnologia piombo in una piattaforma standard del settore e ecosistema. Formerai il team che mantiene FlashDreams veloce, rende OmniDreams utile nei flussi di lavoro reali, e aiuta i clienti e i ricercatori ad avere successo con lo stack. Il successo significa più che il software di spedizione: significa soluzioni di alta qualità, release affidabili, prestazioni forti, sviluppatori impegnati e feedback di ricerca che i composti. Potrai lavorare insieme a team di ricerca eccezionali e leadership NVIDIA. Se trasformare la ricerca rivoluzionaria in qualcosa di sviluppatori si basano su ogni giorno suoni come il miglior lavoro che si può immaginare, ci piacerebbe parlare. Cosa farai:
• Scale la piattaforma interattiva di NVIDIA di team di progettazione in OmniDreams, FlashDreams, tecnologie AlpaSim.
• Stabilire il percorso di ingegneria di produzione per i modelli mondiali interattivi in AV, rendering, robotica e simulazione.
• Costruire l'architettura e i processi necessari per trasformare rapidamente la ricerca in software di sviluppo affidabile.
• Eccellenza di prodotto e ingegneria: performance, scalabilità, affidabilità, esperienza di sviluppo, CI/CD e gestione del rilascio.

descriptionByLocale.en:
NVIDIA's OmniDreams and FlashDreams are the foundation for a new generation of interactive world-model systems. With this release, NVIDIA has set the standard for fidelity, real-time inference performance in world models. And, we've put our work in the open with an open weights model release with an associated open source inferencing engine. We are on a mission to keep raising that bar, making interactive world models viable wherever dynamic worlds matter: autonomous vehicles, robotics, rendering, and simulation. We are seeking an engineering leader to transform this technology lead into an industry standard platform and ecosystem. You will form the team that keeps FlashDreams fast, makes OmniDreams useful in real workflows, and helps customers and researchers succeed with the stack. Success means more than shipping software: it means high-quality solutions, trusted releases, strong performance, engaged developers, and research feedback that compounds. You'll work alongside outstanding research teams and NVIDIA leadership. If turning breakthrough research into something developers rely on every day sounds like the best job you can envision, we'd love to talk. What you'll be doing:
• Scale the engineering team building NVIDIA's interactive world-model platform across OmniDreams, FlashDreams, AlpaSim technologies.
• Establish the production engineering path for interactive world models in AV, rendering, robotics, and simulation.
• Build the architecture and processes needed to turn fast paced research into reliable developer-facing software.
• Own product and engineering excellence: performance, scalability, reliability, developer experience, CI/CD, and release management.
• Partner with research, simulation, rendering, and AV teams to translate world-model breakthroughs into production-ready platform capabilities.
• Grow the open developer and research ecosystem around NVIDIA's world-model stack. What we need to see:
• Demonstrated research or applied innovation in world models, video diffusion, neural rendering, Gaussian splatting / NeRFs, neural reconstruction, neural shading, simulation, robotics, or AV.
• Technical fluency in the ML primitives behind interactive world models, including diffusion or flow-matching models, autoregressive / causal video generation, self-forcing or causal-forcing style training, Gaussian splatting, NeRFs, and neural reconstruction.
• Demonstrated experience turning research-stage systems into dependable, scalable products.
• 12+ overall years experience, 5+ years leading teams.
• Bachelors degree or equivalent experience.
• Results-focused leadership: you build the process, hit the dates, and hold the quality bar. Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Experience adopting Gaussian splats, NeRFs, neural reconstruction, neural shading, or other advanced rendering techniques for AV, robotics, simulation, synthetic data, or production rendering workflows.
• Hands-on experience building, adapting, or deeply evaluating world models, video generation systems, neural rendering systems, Gaussian splatting / NeRF pipelines, or neural shading techniques.
• Experience moving from earlier neural rendering approaches, such as NeRFs or Gaussian splatting, toward generative world models for interactive simulation, rendering, robotics, or AV.
• Published or peer-recognized work advancing the state of the art in world models, neural rendering, generative simulation, video generation, or production ML infrastructure.
• Experience building developer ecosystems or research communities around open-source projects.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Siamo alla ricerca di uno scienziato di apprendimento approfondito altamente motivato con una passione per i modelli di lingua multimodale. Unisciti al nostro team NVIDIA di livello mondiale, che spazia in Finlandia, Germania, Paesi Bassi e Stati Uniti, dietro lavori pionieristici come Megatron-Energon , Nemotron 3 Nano Omni e i nostri ultimi dataset post-formazione! Come contributore fondamentale all’iniziativa multimodale Nemotron di NVIDIA, stiamo spingendo le frontiere dei modelli multimodali open source all’avanguardia. Abbiamo una prospettiva unica in quanto ci sforziamo di modelli aperti, pesi aperti, dati aperti. La nostra missione è semplice: creare modelli che si esibiscono eccezionalmente nelle applicazioni del mondo reale proprio fuori dalla scatola, potenziando e avanzando l'ecosistema LLM multimodale più ampio. Come gruppo di ricerca applicato, abbiamo la priorità di fornire impatto tangibile e risolvere i problemi del mondo reale. Siamo più entusiasti quando l'apprendimento profondo si muove oltre la teoria in produzione su scala. Se si condivide una prospettiva pragmatica e orientata alla consegna e la cura di trasformare la ricerca in realtà, questo team si sentirà come la casa giusta! Cosa farai:
• Spingere i confini della famiglia NVIDIA Nemotron Omni di modelli per consentire potenti applicazioni a valle, tra cui l'intelligenza dei documenti, il ragionamento matematico, multi-turn sistemi di dialogo multimodale, e avanzati software e assistenti agentici. Il ruolo abbraccia l'intera pipeline, dal pre-training al post-training.
• Aiutaci a preparare set di dati multimodali su larga scala per formare modelli di fondazione all'avanguardia attraverso testo, immagine, audio e video. Ciò include lo sviluppo di robusti pipeline di elaborazione dei dati per la cura di dati di formazione di alta qualità, l'aumento, la generazione sintetica di etichette e la fornitura dell'infrastruttura per caricare e servire i dati in tempo reale.
• Collaborare a livello globale con altri membri del team, ricercatori e sviluppatori di diversi dipartimenti nelle startup NVIDIA e AI con cui lavoriamo, per trasformare la ricerca e le innovazioni in prodotti di impatto. Cosa dobbiamo vedere:
• M.Sc. o Ph.D. in Informatica (o un campo correlato), o esperienza di ricerca equivalente in LLM, sistemi o aree connesse.
• 10+ anni di esperienza nel settore della visione informatica, tra cui la progettazione di datadotti per diverse modalità di dati e la distribuzione di modelli dalla ricerca alla produzione.
• Forte comprensione delle basi teoriche di LLM/VLM e familiarità con gli ultimi sviluppi accademici nel campo.
• Competenze di codifica solid hands-on con PyTorch e Python, esperienza con formazione multi-GPU su cluster di calcolo su larga scala, fluidità con Docker e competenze di sistemi Linux. Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:
• Contributi ai sistemi LLM open source o alle infrastrutture AI su larga scala.
• Precedente progetti legati all'intelligenza artificiale o esperienza imprenditoriale in un dominio strettamente connesso.
• Una traccia accademica di pubblicazioni in deep learning. NVIDIA è ampiamente considerato uno dei datori di lavoro più desiderabili del mondo tecnologico. Abbiamo alcune delle persone più avanzate e laboriose al mondo che lavorano per noi. Se sei creativo e autonomo, vogliamo sentirti!
descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Applied Deep Learning Scientist with a passion for multimodal language models. Join our world-class NVIDIA team, spanning Finland, Germany, the Netherlands, and the USA, behind pioneering work such as Megatron-Energon , Nemotron 3 Nano Omni and our latest post-training datasets ! As a core contributor to NVIDIA’s Nemotron multimodal initiative, we are pushing the frontiers of state-of-the-art open-source multimodal models. We have a unique perspective in that we strive for open models, open weights, open data. Our mission is straightforward: create models that perform exceptionally in real-world applications right out of the box, while empowering and advancing the broader multimodal LLM ecosystem. As an applied research group, we prioritize delivering tangible impact and solving real-world problems. We’re most excited when deep learning moves beyond theory into production at scale. If you share a pragmatic, delivery-focused perspective and care about turning research into reality, this team will feel like the right home! What you will be doing:
• Push the boundaries of the NVIDIA Nemotron Omni family of models to enable powerful downstream applications, including document intelligence, mathematical reasoning, multi-turn multimodal dialogue systems, and advanced software & agentic assistants. The role spans the full pipeline, from pre-training through post-training.
• Help us prepare large-scale multimodal datasets to train cutting-edge foundation models across text, image, audio and video. This includes developing robust data processing pipelines to curate high-quality training data, augmenting it, synthetically generating labels and providing the infrastructure to load and serve data in real time.
• Collaborate globally with other team members, researchers and developers from different departments at NVIDIA and AI startups we work with, to turn research and innovations into impactful products. What we need to see:
• M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Computer science (or a related field), or equivalent research experience in LLMs, systems, or connected areas.
• 10+ years of industry experience in computer vision, including designing data pipelines for diverse data modalities and deploying models from research into production.
• Strong understanding of the theoretical foundations of LLMs/VLMs and familiarity with the latest academic developments in the field.
• Solid hands-on coding skills with PyTorch and Python, experience with multi-GPU training on large-scale compute clusters, fluency with Docker, and Linux systems expertise. Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Contributions to open-source LLM systems or large-scale AI infrastructure.
• Previous AI-related projects or entrepreneurial experience in a closely connected domain.
• An academic track record of publications in deep learning. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Dazu gehört die Entwicklung robuster Datenverarbeitungspipelines, um hochwertige Trainingsdaten zu kuratieren, sie zu erweitern, Etiketten synthetisch zu erzeugen und die Infrastruktur zum Laden und Servieren von Daten in Echtzeit bereitzustellen.
• Arbeiten Sie weltweit mit anderen Teammitgliedern, Forschern und Entwicklern aus verschiedenen Abteilungen von NVIDIA- und KI-Startups zusammen, um Forschung und Innovationen in wirkungsvolle Produkte zu verwandeln. Was wir sehen müssen:
• M.Sc. oder Ph.D. in Informatik (oder einem verwandten Bereich) oder gleichwertige Forschungserfahrung in LLMs, Systemen oder verbundenen Bereichen.
• 10+ Jahre Industrieerfahrung im Bereich Computer Vision, einschließlich der Entwicklung von Datenpipelines für verschiedene Datenmodalitäten und der Bereitstellung von Modellen aus der Forschung in die Produktion.
• Starkes Verständnis der theoretischen Grundlagen von LLMs / VLMs und Vertrautheit mit den neuesten akademischen Entwicklungen auf dem Gebiet.
• Solide praktische Programmierkenntnisse mit PyTorch und Python, Erfahrung mit Multi-GPU-Training in großen Rechenclustern, fließend mit Docker und Linux-System-Know-how. Möglichkeiten, sich von der Masse abzuheben:
• Beiträge zu Open-Source-LLM-Systemen oder großer KI-Infrastruktur.
• Frühere KI-bezogene Projekte oder unternehmerische Erfahrung in einem eng verbundenen Bereich.
• Eine akademische Erfolgsbilanz von Publikationen im Bereich Deep Learning. NVIDIA gilt weithin als einer der begehrtesten Arbeitgeber der Technologie weltweit. Wir haben einige der fortschrittlichsten und fleißigsten Menschen der Welt, die für uns arbeiten. Wenn Sie kreativ und autonom sind, möchten wir von Ihnen hören!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous recherchons un Senior Applied Deep Learning Scientifique très motivé et passionné par les modèles de langage multimodal. Rejoignez notre équipe de classe mondiale NVIDIA, couvrant la Finlande, l'Allemagne, les Pays-Bas et les États-Unis, derrière le travail pionnier comme Megatron-Energon , Nemotron 3 Nano Omni et nos derniers ensembles de données post-formation ! En tant que principal contributeur à l'initiative multimodale de NVIDIA, nous repoussons les frontières des modèles multimodaux open source les plus modernes. Nous avons une perspective unique en ce sens que nous nous efforçons de créer des modèles ouverts, des poids ouverts, des données ouvertes. Notre mission est simple : créer des modèles qui fonctionnent exceptionnellement dans les applications du monde réel directement en dehors de la boîte, tout en autonomisant et en faisant progresser l'écosystème multimodal de LLM. En tant que groupe de recherche appliquée, nous accordons la priorité à la réalisation d'impacts tangibles et à la résolution de problèmes réels. Nous sommes les plus excités quand l'apprentissage profond va au-delà de la théorie dans la production à l'échelle. Si vous partagez une perspective pragmatique et axée sur la prestation et que vous vous souciez de transformer la recherche en réalité, cette équipe se sentira comme la bonne maison! Ce que vous ferez :
• Poussez les limites de la famille de modèles NVIDIA Nemotron Omni pour permettre de puissantes applications en aval, y compris l'intelligence documentaire, le raisonnement mathématique, les systèmes de dialogue multimodal multi-tours, et les assistants logiciels et agents avancés. Le rôle s'étend sur toute la ligne, depuis la pré-formation jusqu'à la post-formation.
• Aidez-nous à préparer des ensembles de données multimodales à grande échelle pour former des modèles de base de pointe à travers le texte, l'image, l'audio et la vidéo. Il s'agit notamment de mettre au point des pipelines de traitement de données robustes pour stocker des données de formation de haute qualité, les augmenter, produire des étiquettes synthétiques et fournir l'infrastructure nécessaire pour charger et servir les données en temps réel.
• Collaborer à l'échelle mondiale avec d'autres membres de l'équipe, des chercheurs et des développeurs de différents départements aux start-up NVIDIA et AI avec lesquels nous travaillons pour transformer la recherche et les innovations en produits efficaces. Ce que nous devons voir :
• M.Sc. ou Ph.D. en informatique (ou un domaine connexe), ou expérience de recherche équivalente dans les LLM, les systèmes ou les domaines connectés.
• 10 ans et plus d'expérience de l'industrie dans la vision informatique, y compris la conception de pipelines de données pour diverses modalités de données et le déploiement de modèles de la recherche à la production.
• Compréhension des fondements théoriques des LLM/VLM et connaissance des derniers développements académiques dans le domaine.
• Solides compétences de codage pratique avec PyTorch et Python, expérience avec la formation multi-GPU sur les clusters de calcul à grande échelle, la fluidité avec Docker, et l'expertise des systèmes Linux. Des façons de se démarquer de la foule :
• Contributions à des systèmes LLM à source ouverte ou à une infrastructure d'IA à grande échelle.
• Projets antérieurs liés à l'IA ou expérience entrepreneuriale dans un domaine étroitement lié.
• Une expérience universitaire de publications en apprentissage profond. NVIDIA est largement considéré comme l'un des employeurs les plus souhaitables du monde de la technologie. Nous avons quelques-uns des gens les plus tournés vers l'avenir et les plus travailleurs du monde qui travaillent pour nous. Si vous êtes créatif et autonome, nous voulons vous entendre !

descriptionByLocale.it:
NVIDIA sta trasformando la grafica del computer, il gioco del PC e l'elaborazione accelerata da più di 25 anni. È un’eredità unica dell’innovazione alimentata da una grande tecnologia e da persone incredibili. Oggi, stiamo toccando il potenziale illimitato di AI per definire la prossima era di calcolo. Un'epoca in cui la nostra GPU agisce come il cervello di computer, robot e auto-driving automobili che possono comprendere il mondo. Fare ciò che non è mai stato fatto prima di prendere visione, innovazione e il miglior talento del mondo. Come NVIDIAN, sarete immersi in un ambiente diversificato e di supporto, dove tutti si ispirano a fare il loro lavoro migliore. Unisciti alla squadra e scopri come puoi avere un impatto duraturo sul mondo. Stiamo cercando un leader di ingegneria per guidare la prossima evoluzione dell'interazione digitale dei dipendenti attraverso EMEA. Come leader di End User Support Engineering presso EMEA IT, NVIDIA, ti siederai all'intersezione dell'infrastruttura IT, del supporto, dell'intelligenza artificiale e dell'eccellenza dell'ingegneria, possedendo il ciclo di vita completo di come i dipendenti attraverso la tecnologia dell'esperienza della regione. Questo non è un ruolo di leadership di supporto IT tradizionale. Costruirete e guiderete un team di ingegneri che supportano la produttività dei dipendenti nella regione e a livello globale. Inoltre, progettare, automatizzare e migliorare continuamente la produttività dei dipendenti attraverso pratiche ingegneristiche scalabili, flussi di lavoro AI e un profondo impegno per l'affidabilità operativa. Cosa farai:
• In questo ruolo di leader di ingegneria, definirai e realizzerai una roadmap ingegneristica per il supporto utente finale EMEA. La roadmap corrisponderà alla strategia globale IT e alle priorità aziendali.
• Guidare la strategia e l'esecuzione per incorporare agentic AI in flussi di lavoro di supporto IT - da sistemi di triage intelligente e auto-guarigione a pipeline di risoluzione completamente autonomi. Partner con i team AI/ML per progettare, distribuire e iterare su agenti AI che riducono il volume dei biglietti, accelerano la risoluzione e prevengono proattivamente i problemi prima che i dipendenti li avvisino.
• Guidare con una visione del prodotto: trattare l'esperienza della tecnologia dei dipendenti come un prodotto, con metriche critiche, cicli di iterazione e loop di miglioramento continuo. Identificare i punti di attrito nel viaggio tecnologico dei dipendenti e le soluzioni ingegneristiche che migliorano in modo misurabile esperienza, soddisfazione e produttività.
• Costruire e sviluppare un team di ingegneria altamente performante e geograficamente distribuito in EMEA; ingegneri e manager di mentore a tutti i livelli.
• Definire e possedere obiettivi specifici di EMEA e risultati chiave, SLA e KPI di ingegneria per il supporto degli utenti finali; segnalare i progressi alla leadership senior con chiarezza e responsabilità.
• Costruire relazioni di fiducia con i leader regionali di business, HR, Legale e Workplace team per allineare gli investimenti di ingegneria IT alle esigenze della forza lavoro. Rappresentare EMEA come leader del sito di ingegneria, influenzando le decisioni IT globali con contesto regionale e informazioni informatiche.
• Agire come leader di risposta agli incidenti per EMEA, garantire operazioni e salute continui del sito, guidare la risposta e la risoluzione degli incidenti globali e garantire l'affidabilità della piattaforma attraverso il monitoraggio proattivo, l'automazione e i framework di risposta agli incidenti allineati alle SLA aziendali.
• Dimostrare eccellenti capacità di leadership e comunicazione, con una storia comprovata di costruire relazioni positive con il business e consentire risultati di successo. Cosa dobbiamo vedere:
• 12+ anni complessivi di esperienza nell'ingegneria informatica, nell'infrastruttura o nella tecnologia degli utenti finali, con almeno 6 anni di ruoli di gestione delle persone o di leadership ingegneristica.
• Dimostrati record dei principali team di ingegneria in scala in ambienti complessi, multi-paese o multi-regionali — Esperienza EMEA fortemente preferita.
• Sfondo a mano in sistemi/ingegneria delle infrastrutture: forte esperienza di contributo individuale in almeno un'area (ingegneria endpoint, rete, identità, piattaforme cloud o automazione).
• Esperienza comprovata nella realizzazione e distribuzione dei flussi di lavoro alimentati dall'IA
descriptionByLocale.en:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. We are seeking an engineering leader to drive the next evolution of employee digital interaction across EMEA. As the leader of End User Support Engineering at EMEA IT, NVIDIA, you will sit at the intersection of IT infrastructure, Support, agentic AI, and engineering excellence — owning the full lifecycle of how employees across the region experience technology. This is not a traditional IT support leadership role. You will build and lead a team of engineers who support productivity of employees in the region and globally. In addition, you will design, automate, and continuously improve the employee productivity through scalable engineering practices, AI workflows, and a deep commitment to operational reliability. What you will be doing:
• In this engineering leader role, you will define and carry out an engineering roadmap for EMEA end user support. The roadmap will match the global IT strategy and business priorities.
• Lead the strategy and execution for embedding agentic AI into IT support workflows — from intelligent triage and self-healing systems to fully autonomous resolution pipelines. Partner with AI/ML teams to design, deploy, and iterate on AI agents that reduce ticket volume, accelerate resolution, and proactively prevent issues before employees notice them.
• Lead with a product outlook: treat the employee technology experience as a product, with critical metrics, iteration cycles, and continuous improvement loops. Identify friction points in the employee technology journey and engineer solutions that measurably improve experience, satisfaction, and productivity.
• Build and develop a high-performing, geographically distributed engineering team across EMEA; mentor engineers and engineering managers at all levels.
• Define and own EMEA-specific objectives and key results, SLAs, and engineering KPIs for end user support; report progress to senior leadership with clarity and accountability.
• Build trusted relationships with regional business leaders, HR, Legal, and Workplace teams to align IT engineering investments to workforce needs. Represent EMEA as an engineering site leader, influencing global IT decisions with regional context and data-informed insights.
• Act as the incident response leader for EMEA, ensuring continuous site operations and health, driving global incident response and resolution, and ensuring platform reliability through proactive monitoring, automation, and incident response frameworks aligned to enterprise SLAs.
• Demonstrate excellent leadership and communication skills, with a proven history of building positive relationships with the business and enabling successful outcomes. What we need to see:
• 12+ overall years of experience in IT engineering, infrastructure, or end user technology, with at least 6 years in people management or engineering leadership roles.
• Demonstrated track record of leading engineering teams at scale in complex, multi-country or multi-regional environments — EMEA experience strongly preferred.
• Hands-on background in systems/infrastructure engineering: strong prior individual contributor experience in at least one area (endpoint engineering, network, identity, cloud platforms, or automation).
• Proven experience in crafting and deploying AI-powered workflows

Eine Ära, in der unsere GPU als Gehirn von Computern, Robotern und selbstfahrenden Autos fungiert, die die Welt verstehen können. Zu tun, was noch nie zuvor getan wurde, erfordert Vision, Innovation und die besten Talente der Welt. Treten Sie dem Team bei und sehen Sie, wie Sie die Welt nachhaltig beeinflussen können. Wir suchen einen Ingenieurführer, der die nächste Entwicklung der digitalen Interaktion von Mitarbeitern in EMEA vorantreiben wird. Als Leiter des End User Support Engineering bei EMEA IT, NVIDIA, sitzen Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen IT-Infrastruktur, Support, Agentic AI und Engineering Excellence und besitzen den gesamten Lebenszyklus, wie Mitarbeiter in der gesamten Region Technologie erleben. Identifizieren Sie Reibungspunkte in der Technologiereise der Mitarbeiter und entwickeln Sie Lösungen, die Erfahrung, Zufriedenheit und Produktivität messbar verbessern.
• Aufbau und Entwicklung eines leistungsstarken, geografisch verteilten Engineering-Teams in der gesamten EMEA-Region; Mentor Ingenieure und Engineering-Manager auf allen Ebenen.
• Definieren und eigene EMEA-spezifische Ziele und Schlüsselergebnisse, SLAs und technische KPIs für die Endbenutzerunterstützung; berichten Sie den Fortschritt der Führungsebene mit Klarheit und Rechenschaftspflicht.

Repräsentieren Sie EMEA als führender Engineering-Standort und beeinflussen Sie globale IT-Entscheidungen mit regionalem Kontext und datengestützten Erkenntnissen.
• Handeln Sie als führendes Unternehmen für Incident Response in der EMEA-Region und gewährleisten Sie den kontinuierlichen Betrieb und den Zustand des Standorts, fördern Sie die globale Reaktion und Lösung von Vorfällen und gewährleisten Sie die Zuverlässigkeit der Plattform durch proaktive Überwachungs-, Automatisierungs- und Incident Response-Frameworks, die auf Unternehmens-SLAs ausgerichtet sind.
• Demonstrieren Sie hervorragende Führungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit einer bewährten Geschichte des Aufbaus positiver Beziehungen zum Unternehmen und erfolgreichen Ergebnissen. Was wir sehen müssen:
• 12+ Gesamtjahre Erfahrung in IT-Engineering, Infrastruktur oder Endbenutzertechnologie, mit mindestens 6 Jahren in Personalmanagement- oder Engineering-Führungspositionen.
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz führender Ingenieurteams in großem Maßstab in komplexen, länderübergreifenden oder multiregionalen Umgebungen — EMEA-Erfahrung stark bevorzugt.
• Hands-on-Hintergrund im System- / Infrastruktur-Engineering: Starke Erfahrung einzelner Mitwirkender in mindestens einem Bereich (Endpoint Engineering, Netzwerk, Identität, Cloud-Plattformen oder Automatisierung).
• Bewährte Erfahrung in der Erstellung und Bereitstellung von KI-basierten Workflows
descriptionByLocale.fr:
NVIDIA transforme le graphisme informatique, le jeu PC et l'informatique accélérée depuis plus de 25 ans. Aujourd'hui, nous utilisons le potentiel illimité de l'IA pour définir la prochaine ère de l'informatique. Une époque où notre GPU agit comme le cerveau d'ordinateurs, de robots et de voitures autonomes qui peuvent comprendre le monde. Faire ce qui n'a jamais été fait avant prend la vision, l'innovation, et le monde des meilleurs talents. En tant que NVIDIAN, vous serez immergé dans un environnement diversifié et solidaire où tout le monde est inspiré à faire son meilleur travail. Venez rejoindre l'équipe et voir comment vous pouvez avoir un impact durable sur le monde. Vous allez construire et diriger une équipe d'ingénieurs qui soutiennent la productivité des employés dans la région et dans le monde. De plus, vous concevez, automatisez et améliorez continuellement la productivité des employés grâce à des pratiques d'ingénierie évolutives, à des workflows d'IA et à un engagement profond envers la fiabilité opérationnelle. Ce que vous ferez :
• Dans ce rôle de chef de file en ingénierie, vous définirez et réaliserez une feuille de route en ingénierie pour le soutien de l'utilisateur final de l'EMEA. La feuille de route correspondra à la stratégie informatique globale et aux priorités opérationnelles.

Faites équipe avec les équipes d'IA/ML pour concevoir, déployer et itérer des agents d'IA qui réduisent le volume des billets, accélèrent la résolution et préviennent les problèmes de façon proactive avant que les employés les remarquent.

Identifier les points de friction dans le parcours technologique des employés et les solutions d'ingénieur qui améliorent l'expérience, la satisfaction et la productivité.

Représenter l'EMEA en tant que chef de site d'ingénierie, influençant les décisions mondiales en matière de TI en tenant compte du contexte régional et des données.

• Expérience démontrée d'équipes d'ingénieurs de premier plan à l'échelle dans des environnements complexes, multinationaux ou multirégionaux — expérience de l'EMEA fortement préférée.
• Expérience pratique dans le domaine de l'ingénierie des systèmes et des infrastructures : solide expérience préalable de contributeur individuel dans au moins un domaine (ingénierie de point, réseau, identité, plateformes cloud, ou automatisation).
• Expérience éprouvée dans l'élaboration et le déploiement de flux de travail alimentés par l'IA
